title: Request to toggle Bluetooth on/off via custom shortcut
line: Bluetooth can now be turned on and off with a global shortcut, by default the Bluetooth key, with an on-screen "Bluetooth On/Off" message.

title: Allow keyboard shortcut to trigger the new search field in the global menu on wayland
line: A new "Search Application Menu" global shortcut opens the Global Menu's search with the cursor already in the field.

title: Vault-specific CLI interface so you don't need to interact with cryfs, encfs, gocryptfs etc binaries directly
line: A new plasma-vault command lists, unlocks and locks vaults from a terminal, asking for the password in the usual Plasma Vault dialog.

title: Option to transform minimized windows into thumbnails of in place of icons when using the "Do not group" setting
line: The task manager can now show minimized windows as small previews of the window instead of the app icon.

title: Options for what to do on ctrl-click
line: The Task Manager has a new "Ctrl+clicking grouped task" setting, so Ctrl+click can open the window list or previews while a normal click still cycles through windows.

title: Do not hide the notifications icon if they are not deleted
line: The Notifications icon now stays in the System Tray while there are notifications in its history, instead of hiding as soon as you open it once.

title: Show complete information after copy job has finished
line: Finished and failed file transfers keep a Details button that shows the source, destination, sizes, average speed and how long the transfer took.

title: Show desktop preview (w/windows) in Activity Switcher
line: Each activity in the Activity Switcher now shows its open windows on top of its wallpaper, like the pager does.

title: Ability to configure notifications for all events with apps that don't support per-event settings
line: Apps without their own notification events, like web browsers, now have a "Play a sound" option in their notification settings.

title: separate VPN and wifi connections in networkmanager applet
line: The Networks widget now lists VPN connections in their own "VPN" section, below the Wi-Fi and wired networks.

title: Hide autohiding panel on mouseover after a task demands attention
line: An auto-hide panel that popped up because a window wants attention now hides again once you move the pointer away from it.

title: Allow manual grouping even if "Do not group" has been chosen in the options
line: With grouping set to "Manually", you can group the windows of chosen programs from the task's context menu.

title: Visually differentiate the icons of playing vs non-playing apps
line: The Media Player widget now shows a small playing badge on the tabs of players that are currently playing.

title: Lock screen should clear the password entered when left idle
line: A password typed on the lock screen but never submitted is now cleared when the prompt fades out after a few seconds of inactivity.

title: Show some hour numbers in analog clock SVG
line: The Breeze analog clock now shows the numbers 3, 6 and 9 alongside the 12.

title: Mouseover a day should show the day's events
line: Hovering a day in the clock's calendar now shows a tooltip listing that day's events.

title: Movable border between events and timezones
line: In the clock popup you can now drag the line between Events and Time Zones, and the size is remembered.

title: Allow to set custom icon for bluetooth devices
line: You can now pick your own icon for each Bluetooth device from its page in System Settings, and the Bluetooth widget uses it.

title: Make the styling for minimized Tasks more pronounced
line: Minimized windows now show a dimmed icon in the Task Manager, so they are easy to tell apart from open ones.

title: With BorderlessMaximizedWindows turned on, allow dragging maximized window from empty space in top Panel
line: Dragging the empty space of a top panel now pulls the maximized window below it out of maximization and moves it, as if dragging its titlebar.

title: Provide unique icons for each wallpaper plugin
line: The Haenau, Hunyango and Tiled wallpaper plugins now each have their own icon instead of the same generic wallpaper icon.

title: Option to display time zone as "Time zone city (Time zone code)"
line: The Digital Clock can now show time zones as city and code, like "London (GMT)".

title: Add option to change step size for brightness changes via standard scroll or keyboard shortcut
line: Energy Saving's advanced settings now have a "Brightness change step" that sets how much brightness keys and scrolling over the brightness widget change the screen brightness.

title: Show OSD feedback when audio output is disabled via Icons-Only Task Manager Icon
line: Clicking the speaker badge on a Task Manager icon now shows an "App Muted" OSD, and the app's volume when unmuting.

title: Need an easy way to switch all input and output streams from one device to another
line: The Audio Volume widget's device menu can now switch both playback and recording to a headset in one click.

title: Display the number of notifications on the systray instead of the bell when applet is always visible
line: The Notifications icon now shows the number of unread notifications in a small badge on the bell.

title: Automatic background color detection for non-fullscreen wallpapers
line: Image, Slideshow and Picture of the Day wallpapers can now fill the space around a picture that doesn't cover the screen with the picture's own edge color.

title: Easier access to rotate graphics tablet by adding an Plasmoid and shortcuts
line: Two new global shortcuts, Rotate Drawing Tablet Clockwise and Counterclockwise, turn the tablet by 90° and show an OSD with the new orientation.

title: Consistent Titlebar and Notification OSD Header look and behavior
line: Notification close, minimize and configure buttons now sit on the same side as the window titlebar buttons, so with a Mac-style layout they move to the left.

title: Separate Klipper saved items according to activities
line: The clipboard can now keep a separate history for each activity, so items copied in one activity no longer show up in another.

title: Grouping feature like with macOS Stacks
line: The desktop can now group files of the same type into stacks, and clicking a stack shows its files in a popup.

title: Limit of charging seems to be set only for one battery even in laptop there are multiple
line: On laptops with two batteries, Advanced Power Settings now has a Battery selector so each battery gets its own charge limit.

title: Allow for empty Title text in system monitor applet
line: A System Monitor widget whose title was cleared no longer shows a "System Monitor" tooltip when hovered.

title: Quiet time - add ability to automatically mute all/some devices according to times or events
line: Sound settings now have quiet hours that mute all audio between two times, and again on login or wake-up if it was unmuted in between.

title: Option to animate or badge folder view compact representation upon content change
line: A Folder View widget in the panel now shows a badge with the number of new files in its folder until you open it.

title: Show label in Plasma Bluetooth scanning for devices that only have a MAC addresses, not names
line: In the Add Bluetooth Device window, devices without a name are now listed as "Unknown device" with their address instead of a bare MAC address.

title: Visible button in lockscreen to turn off monitors
line: The lock screen now has a "Turn Off Screens" button next to Sleep and Switch User.

title: Implement a method to add a launcher to the panel via right-click
line: Add Widgets now offers a "Launcher Icon" widget that asks which application or command to launch when you add it.

title: Desktop Session menu should not cover up button when clicked
line: On the login screen, the Desktop Session menu now opens above its button and marks the selected session.

title: Add ability to paste Klipper's contents on selection
line: With a new Clipboard option, picking a text entry from the clipboard history pastes it straight into the window you were typing in.

title: Ability to set custom middle click action with modifier key
line: The Task Manager can now do a different thing when you Ctrl+middle-click a task, set in its Behavior settings.

title: Panels should remain mouse-accessible while window is full-screen (not just when maximized)
line: With "Remain active when windows are fullscreen" turned on in Screen Edges, pushing the pointer to a panel's screen edge now reveals the panel over a fullscreen window, and its widgets can be clicked.

title: Provide option for system tray icon to show normal status on machines that are not expected to have internet access
line: A new "Warn when the network has no Internet access" option in the network configuration lets the tray icon stay normal and stops the Limited Connectivity notification on networks without Internet.

title: Applet: use middle click on applet to toggle presentation mode
line: Middle-clicking the Display Configuration icon in the system tray now turns presentation mode on or off.

title: Prompt the user to classify every new network connected to as "trusted/home/work" or "public/insecure" when using a zone-based firewall
line: When firewalld is running, connecting to a network that has no firewall zone yet shows a notification asking whether it is a home or work network or a public one, and saves the answer as its zone.

title: Give us a way to disable the notifications triggered when file operations are started/completed but allow the users to use all their features via Notifications applet
line: A new "Show popups" option for application progress keeps file operations in the notifications applet without popping up, except when they fail.

title: Keep order of activities
line: Activities can be put in any order in System Settings, and the activity switcher can keep that order instead of moving the last used one to the top.

title: Option to display Time Remaining for Panel representation
line: The battery icon can now show the remaining battery time in its badge, turned on from its right-click menu.

title: headphones/headset/mic selector dialog on plug event
line: Plugging something into a headset combo jack now shows a notification asking whether it is headphones, a headset or a microphone, and switches the output and microphone to match.

title: Ability to pin frequently-used files to jumplists
line: Recent files in a task manager entry's context menu can now be pinned, so they stay in a Pinned Files section above the recent ones.

title: Allow grouped instances to be optionally sorted manually or alphabetically instead of by order of opening
line: With the Task Manager set to sort alphabetically, the windows inside a group are now listed alphabetically by title.

title: Overlapping networks with the same SSID are handled confusingly
line: When a saved Wi-Fi network rejects its password while connecting on its own, Plasma now shows a notification with an Enter Password button instead of popping up a password dialog.

title: Option to sort wallpapers
line: The wallpaper list in Desktop and Wallpaper settings has a Sort menu that can show the newest wallpapers first instead of only A to Z.

title: Newly-connected screens/containments should get the same wallpaper as the most-recent existing screen/containment, rather than the default wallpaper
line: A newly connected screen now gets the same wallpaper as your existing screen instead of the default one.

title: Add "Hide minimized window content" sub-option to "Highlight windows when hovering over tasks"
line: The Task Manager can now show minimized windows as a dark silhouette instead of their contents when you hover over their previews.

title: Make the login and lock screens look the same
line: The login screen's keyboard layout and on-screen keyboard buttons now look and work like the lock screen's.

title: Apply visual changes to auto-hide panel while hidden
line: An auto-hidden panel now shows its current state as soon as it's revealed, instead of first showing the old layout and animating to the new one.

title: External synchronization option for the plasma notes applet
line: Sticky notes can now be kept in a file you choose, such as one in a Nextcloud or Syncthing folder, so the same note shows up on several computers.

title: Offer to enable Bluetooth if disabled when trying to join a Bluetooth connection
line: Saved Bluetooth networks now stay in the Networks applet while Bluetooth is off, and Connect turns Bluetooth on and connects.

title: Size should be configurable when in a panel
line: System Monitor widgets in a panel get a "Width in panel" (or "Height in panel") setting, so a chart can be made wider or taller than its automatic size.

title: For grouped tasks, make context menu actions affect all windows
line: With inline grouping in the Task Manager, a window's context menu now has Close All to close every window of its group.

title: Add available clipboard actions for current content on Klipper plasma widget right-click menu
line: Right-clicking the Clipboard widget now offers Invoke Action, Show QR Code and Edit Contents for the current clipboard item.

title: Make it impossible to manually re-order icons when not in manual positioning mode
line: Dragging an icon around a desktop sorted by name, size, type or date no longer switches it to Unsorted; the icon goes back to its sorted place.

title: Grouping Plasmoid on panels should pop up when clicked
line: In a panel, the Grouping widget now shows as an icon that opens its widgets in a popup.

title: Make Do not disturb times configurable with a repeating schedule
line: Do Not Disturb mode can now turn on by itself every day between two times you choose in the Notifications settings.

title: Add a bubble containing audio volume percentage, like the optional battery percentage bubble
line: The Audio Volume widget can now show the current volume percentage in a small badge on its icon, like the battery widget.

title: Allow setting custom password/PIN just for the screen locker
line: You can now set a short PIN in System Settings that unlocks the lock screen, while your account password keeps working everywhere.

title: Provide an agenda view of events that shows e.g. upcoming events for the whole week
line: The Digital Clock's agenda now lists the events of the selected day and the six days after it, grouped by day.

title: Indicate which tasks belong to which desktops when sorting by desktop
line: When the task manager shows windows from all desktops sorted by desktop, a small gap with a separator line now marks where each desktop's windows begin.

title: Allow text to be copied
line: You can now copy the playing track's title and artist from the Media Player widget's context menu, or with Ctrl+C in its popup.

title: Add "Enable clipboard actions" to widget's context menu
line: The Clipboard widget's menu now has a checkable "Show Action Popup Menu When Copying" entry to turn the automatic action menu on and off.

title: Custom action on double click on "empty" desktop area
line: You can now assign a mouse action to a double-click on the empty desktop, for example opening the Application Launcher menu.

title: OSD and applet: add "Extend to top/bottom" options
line: The display OSD and the Display Configuration applet now offer "Extend above" and "Extend below" the built-in screen, next to left and right.

title: Option for showing number of grouped windows on application icon.
line: The Task Manager can now show how many windows a grouped task has, in place of the small "+" under its icon.

title: New option for QML TasksModel: "filterTransients"
line: Widgets that list windows can now include dialogs and other transient windows by setting filterTransients: false on their TasksModel.

title: Option to seek forwards/backwards rather than changing volume upon mouse wheel scrolling on applet
line: The Media Player widget has a new setting to make scrolling over it seek backward and forward instead of changing the volume.

title: Allow disabling 'wrapping around' for feature to switch tasks on scroll
line: The Task Manager has a new "Wrap around" option, so scrolling over it can stop at the first or last task instead of jumping to the other end.

title: Request: Add actions for selecting current desktop
line: Clicking the current desktop in the Pager can now open the Overview, and does so by default.

title: MouseEventInputButton UI is really awkward
line: Adding or changing a desktop mouse action now explains what to click, warns when that button is already used, and Escape cancels it instead of closing the settings window.

title: Show password prompt immediately if lock screen is displayed after a wake-from-sleep
line: After waking from sleep, the lock screen now shows the password field right away instead of just the clock.

title: Improve appearance of popup with colored backgrounds when placed in a panel
line: A coloured Sticky Note in a panel now fills its whole popup, with no grey border around it.

title: Wallpaper cache
line: Images you pick as your wallpaper are now kept in Plasma's wallpaper folder, so deleting or moving the original file no longer resets the desktop to the default.

title: Show a notification after unsafe disconnect of priorly mounted drives
line: Unplugging a USB stick or other removable drive while it is still mounted now shows a notification reminding you to safely remove it first.

title: Show a quicklist the way apps pinned to the Task Manager do
line: An app in an Icon widget now shows the same Places or Recent Files list in its context menu as when it is pinned to the Task Manager.

title: Lock & login screens: Turn off multi-state blur/darkening when using a solid color
line: A plain color lock or login screen wallpaper now keeps its color instead of turning darker when the password prompt appears.

title: Allow user to customize timezone (time zone) names
line: Time zones in the Digital Clock can now be renamed, so Chicago can show up as Houston.

title: Digital Clock widget add custom time format
line: The Digital Clock can now show the time in any custom format, such as 12-hour time without AM/PM or the date and time on one line.

title: Add option for wallpaper to span multiple screens
line: The Image wallpaper has a new "Span across all screens" option that stretches one image over all monitors, each showing its own part.

title: Add option to execute a user command before switching to an activity
line: Scripts placed in an activity's new "activating" and "deactivating" folders now run and finish before Plasma switches to or away from that activity.

title: Add mouse actions for Present Windows and Desktop Grid
line: The desktop's Mouse Actions settings have a new Overview action that opens Overview, Grid View or the window view when you click.

title: Easier way to run apps on the dedicated GPU
line: On computers with a dedicated graphics card, right-clicking an app in Kickoff, Kicker, search results or the Task Manager now offers to run it on that card.

title: Add an option to "always show icon only" for tasks, but continue to show others icon + text.
line: In the Icons-and-Text Task Manager, any program can now be set to show only its icon from its right-click More menu.

title: Kicker backend feature: combined "history/favorites/newly installed" view
line: Kickoff gets a Dashboard page showing your favorite apps, newly installed apps, and recently used apps, files and folders together.

title: Num Lock Indicator on lock and login screens
line: After a wrong password, the lock and login screens now say "Num Lock is on" when it is.

title: Klipper history concept is incompatible with private Activity
line: Text you copy while in a private activity is no longer kept in the clipboard history.

title: Applet that shows keyboard shortcuts
line: A new Keyboard Shortcuts widget lists the global shortcuts, finds them by name or by keys, and runs the one you pick.

title: Disable recent Applications in Kickoff History or reorder items
line: Kickoff has a new "Show applications in History and Frequently Used" checkbox; turning it off shows only recent files there.

title: Exit after repeated key combination
line: Pressing the logout or shutdown shortcut again while the logout screen is open now carries out the action right away.

title: Forward document drops to the containment so the panel creates an icon launcher
line: Dropping a file or link on an empty part of the task manager now offers to add it to the panel as an icon, instead of doing nothing.

title: Inform about critical system messages, e.g. CPU cooling problem
line: Plasma now warns you with a notification when the computer gets close to the temperature at which it would turn itself off.

title: Support "partially saved" password (for tokens like yubikey)
line: For OpenVPN passwords set to "Ask for this password every time", the start of the password can now be saved; the prompt fills it in and the token types the rest.

title: Ability to manually create groups in task manager
line: The task manager's Group setting has a new "Manually" option: drop a window's task on the middle of another task to put them in one group.

title: Activity integration can be more fine-grained.
line: A vault tied to an activity now stays open for two minutes after you switch away, so a quick look at another activity no longer locks it.

title: Display apps with multiple streams as a single item, rather than showing one item per stream
line: The Audio Volume applet now shows an app that plays several streams as one item with one slider, which can be expanded to show each stream.

title: Allow manually re-ordering tray icons
line: System Tray icons can now be put in any order by dragging them in the System Tray settings.

title: Reduce sensitivity to pointer movements for the purpose of waking up the screen to prevent unintentional wake-ups
line: A small accidental bump of the mouse no longer turns the screens back on; moving it on purpose still does.

title: Gradient background option
line: The Plain Color wallpaper can now draw a vertical or horizontal gradient between two colors.

title: 'Add launcher...' window could appear on left click on widget icon if there aren't any launchers yet
line: Clicking an empty Quicklaunch widget now opens the Add Launcher dialog.

title: Feature to display in the network applet the total amount of data sent/received
line: The Networks widget's Speed tab now shows how much data the connection has downloaded and uploaded in total.

title: Don't show events for the current day that are in the past
line: The Digital Clock's event list for today no longer shows events that have already ended.

title: Turn off screen when PM-inhibiting app is not the active app
line: When the app keeping the screen on has all its windows minimized, the screen now dims and turns off as usual while the computer still stays awake.

title: MPRIS Integration
line: Music playing on a phone connected over Bluetooth now shows in the Media Player widget and responds to the media keys.

title: configurable timer setting to turn off the keyboard's backlight
line: Power Management settings now have a "Turn off keyboard backlight" option that switches the keyboard backlight off after its own idle time, even while a video keeps the screen on.

title: Add calendar event by right clicking on a date in widget-clock
line: The clock popup's Add button now opens KOrganizer's new event editor on the day selected in the calendar.

title: Avoid cells overlapping widgets when deciding initial placement of new icons in desktop containment mode (perhaps optionally)
line: New files on the desktop no longer get placed hidden under widgets.

title: Add magnifier while picking a color
line: While picking a color, the cursor becomes a magnifier that shows the nearby pixels enlarged, with the one being picked outlined.

title: Analog Clock has no independent time zone
line: The Analog Clock now has a Time Zone settings page, so each clock can show a different place's time.

title: Add indication of holiday region
line: With several holiday regions enabled, the clock's event list now shows which region each holiday belongs to.

title: Provide a way to modify volume of all devices
line: You can now bind keys, including the volume keys, to change the volume of every output device at once.

title: "Copy Location" context menu action, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a file or folder on the desktop or in a Folder View now offers Copy Location, which copies its path, like in Dolphin.

title: feature request: task manager has option to show tasks from other desktops
line: The Task Manager's "Show tasks" settings can now show only tasks from other desktops, activities or screens, so two task managers can split current and other windows.

title: Provide an option to add new connections from the applet
line: The Networks widget has an Add Connection button that opens the connection type chooser, for hidden Wi-Fi networks, VPNs and more.

title: Allow adding widgets to the lock screen
line: You can now pick widgets in the lock screen settings and they show on the lock screen, for example CPU, memory and network monitors.

title: Allow the user to cancel connection while it's still in progress
line: While a Bluetooth device is connecting, the applet now shows a Disconnect button that cancels the connection.

title: Powerdevil should call logind SetIdleHint on user idle
line: Plasma now tells logind when you are away, so other programs can see that the session is idle.

title: Option to hide file extensions in Folder View in all displayed locations, not just desktop:/
line: Folder View now shows .desktop files by their name, without the .desktop extension, in any local folder, not just the Desktop folder.

title: "Duplicate" context menu action, like in Dolphin
line: Desktop and Folder View icons now have a "Duplicate Here" menu item and Ctrl+D shortcut, like Dolphin.

title: User friendly names should be used for HDMI/DP devices
line: HDMI and DisplayPort outputs now show the name of the connected monitor or receiver instead of the sound card's long name.

title: Way to make all items hidden, not visible
line: The System Tray settings have a "Set All To" menu that changes every entry's visibility at once, for example to show them all only in the popup.

title: Show filename extension for truncated filenames, like Dolphin does
line: Long file names on the desktop now keep their extension visible when shortened, like "Sample filename documen….docx", as Dolphin does.

title: Fade in and out on login and logout
line: Logging out now fades the wallpaper and panels to black instead of cutting straight from the desktop to the login screen.

title: Allow toggling camera access through camera indicator
line: The camera indicator now has an "Allow camera access" switch that makes the system refuse the camera to apps that ask for it.

title: Allow Lock Key Status tray icon to be displayed when NumLock is OFF instead of ON
line: The Lock Keys widget can now show itself when Num Lock or Caps Lock is off, for people who keep Num Lock on.

title: Invalid network certificate error UX could be improved
line: The weather widget no longer pops up a certificate warning dialog when its provider's certificate can't be verified; it shows its own error message instead.

title: When device is in MTP or PTP mode, only show actions relevant to that mode
line: Phones connected in MTP mode no longer offer camera actions like "Download Photos with Gwenview" or digiKam that always failed.

title: Allow a one time change to charging thresholds
line: When a charge limit is set, the battery applet has a Charge Fully Once button, and the limit comes back when the laptop is unplugged.

title: "Clear All Notifications" should animate the notifications disappearing before the popup closes so that it's clear something happened
line: Clear All Notifications now slides the notifications away one after the other before the popup closes.

title: Allow changing password
line: Vaults that use EncFS or gocryptfs now have a Password tab in their Configure dialog for changing the vault's password.

title: Make thumbnails (previews) of copied images bigger in clipboard applet
line: Copied images now show with previews about twice as large in the clipboard popup.

title: Store path to current POTD image in in its config file to enable various useful purposes for other software
line: The Picture of the Day wallpaper now saves the path of the picture it shows in its settings, so other apps can use it.

title: Add ability to snooze a notification
line: Notification popups get a clock button to snooze them for 15 minutes, 1 hour or 4 hours, after which they pop up again.

title: Allow audio device switching from the task icon
line: Right-clicking an app that plays audio in the Task Manager now offers a "Play Audio Using" submenu to send its sound to another output device.

title: Merge the functionality of Active Window Control into Task Manager when borderlessMaximizedWindows mode is active
line: With borderless maximized windows on, the active maximized window's Task Manager entry now has Minimize, Restore and Close buttons next to its title.

title: Feature suggestion: when holding the Meta key, indicate in the icon-only task manager the numbers for each application
line: Holding Meta now shows a number on each of the first nine task manager entries, so you can see which Meta+number opens which app.

title: Please add keyboard shortcuts to open new instances of applications in the task manager
line: Meta+Shift+1 through 9 now open a new window of the matching Task Manager app, or launch it if it is only pinned.

title: Option to open System Monitor with left-click, rather than the expanded view
line: System Monitor widgets in a panel can now be set to open the System Monitor app when clicked, instead of showing their popup.

title: Show playback buttons in panel representation
line: The Media Player widget on a panel now has previous, play/pause and next buttons next to the song title.

title: Optional "smart" time-based charging to 100% when charge limit feature is in use
line: With a charge limit set, you can pick a time in the power settings and a laptop left plugged in overnight is fully charged by then.

title: Suggestion - Disk and Devices on Desktop as icons
line: The desktop can now show connected disks and USB sticks as icons that mount when opened, with a new "Show connected devices" option in its Filter settings.

title: Top Processes widget
line: There is now a ready-made Top Processes widget that lists the processes using the most CPU, with their memory use.

title: Too many clicks required to run a recent application
line: Kickoff's sidebar now has Recent Applications and Recent Files categories right below Favorites, so a recent app is two clicks away instead of four.

title: Option to automatically delete the folder where the vault is mounted when unmounting
line: Each vault can now remove its mount point folder while it is locked, so the empty folder no longer clutters the file manager.

title: provide more city options for timezone configuration
line: The time zone picker now has a city search that finds big cities like Mumbai or Beijing and selects their time zone.

title: Desktop pager should wrap lines when it's configured to show desktop names
line: The pager now wraps long desktop names onto several lines when its cells have room, instead of always cutting them to one line.

title: Add option to display timezone codes in map view comboboxes
line: The time zone picker now shows each zone's code next to the city, like "Tokyo (JST)" or "Los Angeles (PST)".

title: Hide empty sensor categories
line: The System Monitor sensor picker no longer shows categories that have no sensors, like Power on a computer without a battery.

title: Allow playing a stream on multiple arbitrary outputs
line: The Audio settings page has a new Combine Outputs button that creates a playback device which plays on several chosen devices at once.

title: Clicking on the name/album art on the expanded media player widget should open the app
line: Clicking the album art or the song title in the Media Player popup now brings the player's window to the front.

title: Feature Request: on Icons-Only Task Manager, Dolphin should show all Places by default
line: Right-clicking a running Dolphin in the task manager now lists all your Places instead of five and a "more Places…" entry.

title: Improve time display in thin vertical panels
line: In a thin vertical panel the clock now shows hours and minutes stacked in large digits instead of a tiny one-line time.

title: Add a keyboard shortcut to focus the latest notifications that arrived
line: A new "Focus Latest Notification" shortcut lets you reply to or act on the newest notification popup without the mouse.

title: Implement spell checking
line: Sticky notes now underline misspelled words and offer spelling suggestions in their right-click menu.

title: Make settings easier to find
line: The Lock Keys widget now shows Num Lock status by default, not only Caps Lock.

title: Stop respecting screen sleep inhibition on the lock screen
line: Locking the screen now turns it off as configured even while a video or another app is keeping it awake.

title: Plasma should provide an easy way to open its user manual on KDE Linux
line: A "Plasma User Manual" entry in the launcher's Help category opens the Plasma handbook, online when KHelpCenter isn't installed.

title: Add "Turn Off Screen" as an item in the Kicker model
line: Kicker, Kickoff and Application Dashboard now offer Turn Off Screen next to Lock, Log Out and Switch User.

title: Show a timer when locked out for a period of time due to PAM policies
line: After too many failed attempts, the lock screen now keeps showing how many minutes are left before you can try again, counting down.

title: Being able to drag window previews to reorganize their order
line: You can now drag a window's preview in a grouped task's tooltip to change the order of the group's windows.

title: feature suggestion: playback streams shortcuts
line: Every application that plays sound now gets shortcuts in System Settings to raise, lower and mute its own volume.

title: Show keyboard shortcut for launching app next to app name
line: Kickoff now shows an app's launch shortcut, like Meta+E for Dolphin, at the end of its row.

title: Digital Clock: offer button to add time zones to the widget popup itself
line: The clock popup's Time Zones section has a new button that opens the clock settings straight on the Time Zones page.

title: Don't include virtual sinks/sources in global mute behavior, either automatically or optionally
line: The speaker and microphone mute keys no longer mute virtual devices like Easy Effects sinks and sources, unless one is the default device.

title: Middle-click to open with secondary associated application on the desktop
line: Middle-clicking a file on the desktop now opens it with its second associated app (Shift for the third), like in Dolphin.

title: Allow app icons dropped into panel spacers adjacent to task manager to be added to task manager
line: Dropping an app on a spacer next to the task manager now pins it in the task manager instead of adding a separate icon widget.

title: Option to show OSDs on all monitors
line: A new "Show OSD popups: On all screens" option in General Behavior shows volume, brightness and other OSDs, and the Meta+P display selector, on every screen.

title: Notification for when limited connection becomes normal
line: You can now turn on a notification that tells you when Internet access comes back after a period of limited connectivity.

title: Allow smoother Panel thumbnail popup animation
line: Task Manager tooltips now fade in when you move between tasks, and window thumbnails fade in instead of popping in.

title: Add option to remove PM and AM from digital clock widget
line: The Digital Clock has a new "Show AM/PM" option, so a 12-hour clock can show 10:09 instead of 10:09 PM.

title: Notification that says you missed notifications because of "Do not disturb", should mention that it was triggered by being in fullscreen mode
line: When you leave a fullscreen app, the missed-notifications summary now says Do Not Disturb was on because a fullscreen application was focused.

title: Add truncation indicator for long clipboard content
line: The clipboard pop-up now shows every line of an entry and marks how many characters or lines are left out.

title: Change activities when scrolling over the Activity Switcher widget
line: Scrolling over the Activity Switcher widget now switches to the next or previous activity.

title: Smooth panel resizing animation when content size changes
line: Panels set to fit their content now grow and shrink smoothly when a task or widget is added or removed, instead of jumping to the new size.

title: Change keyboard layout OSD to show a list of all layouts, and the active layout's position in that list
line: Switching keyboard layouts now shows all your layouts in the OSD, with the active one highlighted.

title: Lock screen appearance page should be findable in Appearance & Style section
line: System Settings now has a Lock Screen page under Appearance & Style › Colors & Themes for the lock screen's wallpaper and clock.

title: Allowing bigger value for history
line: The Color Picker widget has a new "History size" setting (up to 100 colors), and its history popup scrolls when it holds more than 9.

title: Add ability to do two-finger trackpad swipe left/right between Applications and Places tabs
line: Swiping sideways with two fingers (or scrolling a horizontal mouse wheel) over Kickoff now switches between Applications and Places.

title: [OpenConnect] Explain "Store browser cookies in plain-text" and use a better wording
line: The OpenConnect sign-in dialog now says "Remember web sign-in" and has a help button explaining what it keeps and that it is stored unencrypted.

title: Allow re-pairing already paired bluetooth devices in the pairing dialog
line: The Add Bluetooth Device wizard now lists already paired devices that are nearby and in pairing mode, and can pair them again.

title: Run KRunner runners out-of-process so they can't take down Plasmashell if and when they crash
line: A search plugin that crashed Plasma once now runs in its own process, so it can no longer take down the panels and desktop.

title: Support the NetworkManager ipv6 option "addr-gen-mode"
line: The IPv6 page of a connection now has an Address Generation setting, and saving a connection no longer resets a hand-set EUI-64 or Default mode to Stable privacy.

title: Auto-rotate should be disable-able and enable-able via system tray
line: The Display Configuration applet in the system tray now has a switch to turn automatic screen rotation on and off.

title: Add unmount button for manually-mounted network shares that appear in the widget
line: Network shares in Disks & Devices now have an Unmount button, and a Mount action when they are listed in fstab but not mounted.

title: Allow manually sending all persistent notifications to the history
line: Every notification that stays on screen until you act on it now has a Minimize button that tucks it into the notification history.

title: UI to set keyboard shortcut for standalone widgets that have their "configure" actions overridden to open System Settings KCMs
line: Standalone widgets whose Configure entry opens System Settings (Notifications, Bluetooth, Networks…) now have a "Configure Keyboard Shortcut…" entry in their context menu.

title: Virtual desktop pager should use a compact button for each desktop when "show window outlines" is off
line: With window outlines turned off, the Pager shows each desktop as a small square instead of a screen-shaped rectangle.

title: Hide "block sleep and screen locking after inactivity" UI section when both sleep and screen locking are disabled
line: The Power and Battery popup no longer shows the sleep and screen locking block switch when nothing happens after inactivity anyway.

title: Apply Wrong Password Jitter Only to Password Field
line: After a wrong password, only the password field shakes on the lock and login screens, not the avatar, username or messages around it.

title: "Do not sort" and "Manually" are nonsensical to have as two options
line: The Task Manager's Sort list no longer has a confusing "Do not sort" option; "Manually" gains a "Lock positions" checkbox instead.

title: Panel widget line chart limits make it difficult to see how close line is to maximum
line: System Monitor line charts have a new "Show frame" option that draws a border around the chart, so in a panel you can see where the maximum is.

title: Thai style Buddhist calendar support
line: The Digital Clock's alternate calendars now include the Thai solar calendar, showing dates with Buddhist Era years.

title: Icon spacing setting not available for pinned app icons of Icons-and-Text task manager
line: The Icons-and-Text Task Manager now has the "Spacing between icons" setting, and it spaces pinned app icons like the Icons-only Task Manager does.

title: Add support for managing Wi-Fi P2P (Direct) and mesh connections
line: Wi-Fi P2P (Direct) connections can now be created and edited in the Wi-Fi & Networking settings, and Wi-Fi mesh connections keep their Mesh mode.

title: Toggling mic mute using keyboard shortcut when nothing is using the mic should show the indicator widget anyway
line: Muting the microphones with the shortcut now shows the muted microphone icon in the system tray until they are unmuted.

title: Ability to control brightness of current screen from the keyboard
line: Meta+Brightness Up/Down now change only the brightness of the current screen, while the plain brightness keys still change all screens.

title: When detecting a limited/non-existent connectivity situation, check for restored connectivity more quickly
line: After a brief network hiccup, the "limited connectivity" warning now goes away within 30 seconds instead of staying until NetworkManager's next check minutes later.

title: show a message when network is disabled due to a vault being open
line: Opening a vault set to go offline now shows a notification saying that networking was turned off because of that vault.

title: Language hot switching
line: Changing the language in System Settings now switches the panel and its popups to the new language right away, without logging out.

title: GUI option for reverting klipperClearHistoryAskAgain option is missing
line: After choosing "Do not ask again" when clearing the clipboard history, the question can be turned back on in the clipboard settings.

title: Bubble up errors to the user when session/power actions aren't working
line: When logging out, shutting down, restarting, sleeping, locking or switching user fails, Plasma now shows a notification with the reason instead of silently doing nothing.

title: Icon widget: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources when multiple Icon widgets are sharing the same containment (panel, folder, etc)
line: When two Icon widgets on the same panel or desktop show the same app from different sources, the Flatpak or Snap one now says so in its label and tooltip and gets a small emblem in panels.

title: Application Dashboard: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: When the same app is installed from more than one source, Application Dashboard now labels the copies, like "Firefox (Flatpak)" and "Firefox (Snap)".

title: Kicker: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: When the same app is installed from more than one source, Application Menu now labels the copies, like "Firefox (Flatpak)" and "Firefox (Snap)".

title: Kickoff: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: The launcher now labels Flatpak and Snap copies of an app installed twice, like "Firefox (Flatpak)", instead of showing identical entries.

title: Task Manager: Disambiguate same app installed from different sources
line: When the same app is pinned or open twice from different sources, the Task Manager tooltip now says which one is the Flatpak or Snap.

title: Easy way to see all global shortcuts
line: Pressing Meta+H now shows an overlay listing every global keyboard shortcut, with a search field.

title: close notifications hotkey and/or dbus command (close / clear / remove)
line: A new "Hide Notification Popups" global shortcut hides every notification popup on screen at once, keeping them in the history.

title: Add ability to set color, size and font of system monitor widget
line: The System Monitor widget's Text Only style can now use a custom font (family, style and size) and a custom text color.

title: Feature to expand the Quicklauncher's popup on mouse hover
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Open popup on hover" option that opens its popup when you rest the pointer on the arrow.

title: Feature to assign an icon to the CompactRepresentation
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Popup icon" setting, so its popup button in a panel can show any icon instead of the arrow.

title: Option to display apps as icons only
line: Quicklaunch has a new "Show launcher names in popup" option; turning it off shows the popup as a compact row of icons.

title: Add screen rotate function in "Display Configuration" widget
line: The Display Configuration widget can now rotate your screens with one click.

title: Make it clear when one network/VPN was automatically connected as a precondition of connecting to another one
line: A VPN that connected automatically together with a network now says "Connected automatically with <network>" in the Networks widget.

title: If applicable, allow using "Alternatives" functionality to select new widget for any old incompatible Plasma 5 widgets still installed after Plasma 6 update
line: Right-clicking a widget that can't load, like an old Plasma 5 launcher, now offers Show Alternatives, so it can be swapped for a working one in the same spot with its settings kept.

title: [Feature request] add an option to view previous wallpaper when using wallpaper slideshow style on the desktop
line: Slideshow wallpapers now have a "Previous Wallpaper Image" item in the desktop context menu, next to "Next Wallpaper Image".

title: Request: Being able to display seconds on the clock of the Lock screen
line: The lock screen settings now have a Show seconds option that adds seconds to the lock screen clock.

title: Feature Request: Automatically clone selected panels when connecting a new display
line: Panels can now be set to add a copy of themselves to newly connected screens that have no panels.

title: VPN connection does not provide any details when it fails to connect
line: When a VPN fails to connect, its notification now has a Show Log button that shows why it failed.

title: Feature Request - Add a global slider, for controlling all connected screens' brightness at once, to the Brightness and Color widget
line: With more than one screen, the Brightness and Color popup now has an "All Displays" slider that changes every screen's brightness together.

title: Allow resizing floating Meta+V clipboard popup
line: The Meta+V clipboard popup can now be resized by dragging its edges, and it opens at the size you picked the next time.

title: Support api.met.no in Plasma's Weather widget
line: The Weather widget can now show forecasts from MET Norway (api.met.no), which also finds small towns and villages.

title: Turn off monitor power save when mirroring screen
line: Screens no longer dim, turn off or lock on idle while they are mirrored, like notifications are already silenced.

title: Add text to application launchers when an Icons-and-Text Task Manager is used on a vertical panel, where there's always room for text
line: Pinned apps in the Icons-and-Text Task Manager now show their names on vertical panels.

title: Modifying screen brightness using brightnessctl should be instantly recognized by Plasma
line: Changing the laptop screen brightness with brightnessctl or another tool now updates Plasma's brightness slider and keyboard shortcuts.

title: Add a quick toggle for Bluetooth discoverability in the widget
line: The Bluetooth widget's menu now has a "Visible to nearby devices" checkbox, so you can receive files from an unpaired phone without opening System Settings.

title: Spaces which "partial download files" occupies on Desktop must always be available for any other file type to seamlessly take its place.
line: Files downloaded to the desktop no longer leave empty gaps where their partial download files used to be.

title: Add context menu entry in desktop to toggle visibility of all icons (files and folders)
line: The desktop's right-click Icons menu now has a Show Icons checkbox that hides or shows all files and folders on the desktop.

title: Option to change graph color when it reaches a high level
line: System Monitor widgets can now turn a sensor orange or red when its value goes above a warning or critical percentage you choose.

title: When "Create New" from the Context Menu is selected, or when dragging items; highlight the area it will be dropped/created
line: While you drag icons on the desktop, or pick something from "Create New", the grid cell where the item will land is now highlighted.

title: Volume & Audio applet: Show output device information for each application
line: The Audio Volume applet's Applications tab now shows which device each app is playing to or recording from.

title: Improve date display in thin vertical panels
line: In thin vertical panels, numeric dates like 14/10/2024 now wrap onto several lines instead of shrinking to a tiny font.

title: Show Error message in applet when powerdevil isn't running instead of hiding the applet completely from the tray
line: Brightness & Color now stays in the system tray when the power management service isn't running and explains why brightness can't be adjusted.

title: Don't automatically connect to VPN on reboot by default
line: Imported WireGuard VPN configurations no longer connect automatically at every boot.

title: Show link emblem for all app launchers, not just the ones that are in fact symlinks to a file somewhere else
line: App launchers on the desktop and in Dolphin now always show the link emblem, not only when the file is a symlink.

title: When grouped task popup becomes scrollable, remove side/top paddings to improve Fitts' Law adherence
line: Scrolling a long grouped task tooltip now also works with the pointer on its outer edges.

title: Turn battery icon red at actual user-configured critical threshold, rather than always at 20% remaining battery or less
line: The battery icon now turns red at the low battery level set in the power settings instead of always below 15%.

title: Don't let task enter "needs attention" state when window on a different activity asks for attention
line: The Task Manager has a new "Unless they want attention" option to stop windows from other activities or desktops popping up in it when they want attention.

title: Request for Donation Improvements
line: The yearly donation notification now has a link to see what past donations made possible.

title: Increase the size of circle or some more layout options for binary clock
line: The Binary Clock's dots are now much bigger in the panel, with small gaps between them, so it is readable without a thicker panel.

title: [feature request] customizable screen layout quick options
line: You can save the current screen layout under a name in Display Configuration and switch to it from the Meta+P screen switcher.

title: Battery Critical notification could benefit from a real-time countdown
line: The Battery Critical notification now counts down the seconds left before the system sleeps, hibernates or shuts down.

title: Ability to specify other desktops to also display windows on, not just moving them there (as in the titlebar context menu)
line: The task manager's right-click menu now lets you put a window on several desktops with checkboxes, like the window title bar menu.

title: Notification stacking/grouping
line: A notification identical to an earlier one now replaces it instead of piling up in the popups and the history.

title: Allow reordering of Bluetooth device list
line: The Bluetooth applet lets you add devices to Favorites, which are listed in their own section above the other disconnected devices.

title: Split "Lock Keys Status" widget into multiple ones so each of them can display an icon for one lock key
line: A new Num Lock Status widget can be enabled in the System Tray, so Caps Lock and Num Lock each get their own icon instead of one merged icon.

title: Support accessing multiple notes through one widget
line: One Sticky Note widget, on the desktop or behind a panel icon, can now hold several notes and flip between them.

title: Use an On/Off switch for Keyboard brightness control when there are only two states
line: Keyboard backlights that can only be on or off now get an on/off switch in Brightness & Color instead of a one-step slider.

title: Ways to make the pagers applets take less space
line: The Pager can now show just the current desktop as a small button that opens a menu to switch desktops.

title: Show Bluetooth devices ordered by last used
line: The Bluetooth applet and settings page now list the devices you used most recently first, instead of alphabetically.

title: Drag window (not Task Manager task) to virtual desktop to move it to that virtual desktop
line: Dragging a window by its titlebar onto a desktop in the Pager now moves the window to that desktop.

title: Allow per-widget config window sizes/positions
line: Widgets can now choose how big their settings window opens, so small widgets like Show Activity Manager get a small window.

title: Tag / name pinned clipboard items so that they can be searched for easily
line: Starred clipboard items can be given a name, which is shown above their text and found by the search field.

title: support systemd-homed's "forget keys on suspend"
line: With systemd-homed's lock-on-suspend enabled, waking the computer now shows the login screen, and logging in there unlocks the home folder and returns to the running session.

title: Play animated GIFs
line: Animated GIFs in the Media Frame widget now play, on the desktop as well as in a panel popup.

title: "settings" icon in the right corner of a panel is now pointless and can be removed
line: In edit mode, panels no longer show the redundant settings button at their end, so widgets can use that space.

title: With the bing provider, have an option to download UHD resolution images even if the resolution is 1920 x 1080 or lower.
line: The Bing Picture of the Day wallpaper now always downloads the sharp UHD image instead of the blurry 1080p one on regular landscape screens.

title: Allow the wallpaper colour to adhere to the current theme
line: The Plain Color wallpaper can now follow the color scheme, so it turns dark or light together with the rest of Plasma.

title: Allow different wallpapers per screen orientation
line: The Image wallpaper can now show a different image when the screen is in portrait orientation.

title: Allow removing entries for disconnected screens
line: Manage Desktops and Panels offers Remove Desktop again for screens that are no longer connected, so their leftover entries can be deleted.

title: Add an option to let users select the main date display (Gregorian or alternate calendar).
line: The panel clock can now show its date in the alternate calendar (Persian, Hebrew, Chinese…) by picking "Alternate calendar" as the date format.

title: Retain notification history across plasmashell restarts
line: Notification history is kept when Plasma restarts or crashes, instead of being emptied.

title: Quitting an app that sent a flood of notifications should stop the flood
line: Quitting an app that sent a flood of notifications now stops its popups right away; the notifications stay in history.

title: Widgets should be able to resolve bundled icons and notifyrc files
line: Widgets can now ship their own icon and notification events inside their package.

title: Countdown confirmation for the OSD and Plasma applet
line: Choosing a screen layout from the Meta+P popup or the Display Configuration widget now asks to keep it and goes back to the old layout after 15 seconds.

title: Feature to filter clipboard history by type (text, images, other files, etc)
line: The clipboard popup and widget have a new filter button next to the search field to show only text, images or files.

title: With icons-and-text task manager, a way to close all tasks when they're not grouped
line: When several windows of the same app sit ungrouped in the task manager, their context menu now has Close All to close them all at once.

title: If no AC brightness value has been configured, switching from low battery mode to AC power should restore previous screen brightness
line: Plugging the charger back in after Low Battery dimmed the screen now brings the brightness back to where it was, unless AC has its own brightness set.

title: "Switch to Next Activity" should open Activity Switcher
line: Holding the Switch to Next/Previous Activity shortcut now shows the activity switcher, listing activities in the order the shortcut goes through them.

title: Support controlling the contrast on DDC-supported monitors
line: The Brightness and Color applet now shows a Contrast slider under the brightness of monitors controlled over DDC/CI.

title: Allow saving picture of the day wallpaper directly from lock screen
line: With the Picture of the Day wallpaper, the lock screen has a Save Wallpaper button that saves today's picture to the Pictures folder.

title: Add an option to quickly disable the Colour blindness Correct Effect to the Brightness and Colour widget
line: The Brightness and Color widget now has a switch to quickly turn color blindness correction off and on again.

title: "Keep launchers separate" should work with sorting modes other than manual
line: "Keep launchers separate" can now be turned off in every sort mode except "Do not sort", so pinned apps sort together with open windows.

title: Show picture of the day metadata on the desktop
line: The Picture of the Day wallpaper can now show the picture's title and author on the desktop.

title: Provide feedback about progress of failed Suspend/Sleep job
line: When Sleep or Hibernate fails, Plasma now shows a notification with the reason instead of doing nothing.

title: Desktop Folder Settings has no "revert" or "reset to default" buttons
line: Widget and desktop settings windows now have Defaults and Reset buttons, like System Settings.

title: Detect camera usage from apps accessing the camera in a low-level way (e.g. accessing /dev/video* directly)
line: The camera indicator now also shows cameras used by apps that open them directly, like Chrome, Signal or ffplay.

title: Option to synchronize slideshow wallpapers for multiple screens
line: A random wallpaper slideshow can now show the same image on all screens, changing together, with a new "Show the same image on all screens" option.

title: Panel edit mode: Undo / redo buttons or hotkeys for last changes
line: Edit mode now has Undo and Redo buttons and Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z for adding, removing and moving widgets and adding or removing panels.

title: Continue to show menus for the previously-focused window when focus is lost to the panel or one of its widgets
line: The Global Menu keeps showing the app's menus while the launcher, system tray or another panel popup is open.

title: Increase spacing between top-level menus to match that of in-window menus
line: Global Menu items in the panel are now spaced like the menu bar inside windows.

title: Global menu should still show KWin-provided window management features when a window that doesn't support Global Menu is open
line: The Global Menu now shows a Window menu with minimize, maximize, fullscreen, move, resize, keep above/below, move to desktop and close for apps that have no menu of their own.

title: Menu bar title should flash when an existing keyboard shortcut is invoked
line: Using a keyboard shortcut for a menu item now briefly highlights that menu's title in the Global Menu widget, like on macOS.

title: Group and/or mark tasks according to screen
line: The Task Manager has a new "By screen" sort option that keeps the tasks of each screen together, from the leftmost screen to the right.

title: Add a "turn off screen" button
line: The Brightness & Color applet now has a Turn Off Screen button in its header and right-click menu.

title: Implementing support for LE Audio and Auracast from KDE/Plasma's side
line: LE Audio earbuds, headsets, speakers and hearing aids now show as audio devices in the Bluetooth applet and settings, not as "Other device".

title: Hard to find the feature to set per-applet keyboard shortcuts for applets that don't expose the functionality in their own config windows
line: The System Tray's Keyboard Shortcuts page now lists every tray entry, so each one's shortcut can be set there.

title: Add a checkbox "this network is metered" with required "yes/no" input below the password prompt
line: When you connect to a new Wi-Fi network, you can now mark it as metered right below the password field.

title: Option to add Application Menu as a submenu for the standard context menu
line: The desktop's standard right-click menu can now show an Applications submenu, enabled from its Mouse Actions settings.

title: Add power/session controls (Lock Screen, Leave) to the off-by-default desktop Application Menu launcher thingy
line: The desktop's right-click Application Menu now ends with Lock Screen and Show Logout Screen.

title: Possibility to give an application exclusively audio output
line: Each app in the Audio Volume widget now has a "Mute Other Applications" action that silences every other app at once.

title: Dragging stuff from popup should produce visual feedback
line: Dragging an entry out of the clipboard popup now shows the entry's text, image or file previews under the cursor.

title: [wish] bluetoothsignal strength
line: The Bluetooth widget's device details now show the signal strength, like Wi-Fi networks do.

title: Need to fiddle with unintuitive settings to be able to connect to two Ethernet networks at the same time
line: Connecting a wired network on a second Ethernet card no longer disconnects the first card.

title: Use Milou.ResultsDelegate for search results
line: Kickoff's search results now look and work like KRunner's and Overview's, grouped by category with the result's actions on the right.

title: Allow setting custom font for Sticky Notes
line: Sticky Notes settings now have a "Text font" chooser, so a note can use any installed font instead of only the system font.

title: [Feature Request] klipper: Add the ability to change the order of added actions and commands.
line: In the Clipboard settings, actions and their commands can now be reordered by dragging them.

title: Add separator between known and unknown networks
line: The Networks widget now lists networks you have saved under their own "Saved" header, separate from new networks.

title: Layout of containments on "Manage Desktops and Panels" window should match actual Display Configuration
line: Manage Panels and Desktops now shows screens where they really are: side by side, stacked, or in a grid, with disconnected screens underneath.

title: Astronomical events calendar plugin should show exact time of the astronomical events
line: Moon phases and solstices/equinoxes in the clock's calendar now show the exact time they happen, on the right local day.

title: Support the use case of requiring authenticate to restart/shut down etc.
line: When restarting or shutting down needs a password, Plasma now asks for it instead of ending on a frozen black screen.

title: Sticky note's icon should use icon with corresponding color
line: A Sticky Note in a panel now shows an icon in the note's own color.

title: Allow slideshow wallpapers to be previewed in the same way as static image wallpapers can be previewed
line: In Slideshow mode, each image now has a Preview button that shows it on the desktop with the slideshow's positioning until you apply or close the settings.

title: FEATURE REQUEST: Please add a tablet-mode toggle to the system-tray
line: The Display Configuration tray applet now has a switch to turn Tablet Mode on and off.

title: Provide a button to end a process that is blocking unmount
line: When a device can't be safely removed because apps still use it, Disks & Devices now offers "End Blocking Processes and Remove".

title: Allow the Weather plasmoid to automatically change location to current location
line: The Weather widget can now detect your location automatically and show the weather wherever you are.

title: When using systemd boot, make `plasmashell --replace` warn people that it's for development usage only
line: Running "plasmashell --replace" in a systemd-managed session now prints a warning that it is meant for development and suggests "systemctl restart --user plasma-plasmashell.service".

title: Reduce size of wallpapers by using compressed AVIF as the file format
line: The default and bundled wallpapers now ship as AVIF, so they take about 15 MB on disk instead of 320 MB and load faster.

title: Hide the "Favourites" section when it is empty.
line: Kickoff no longer opens on an empty Favorites page: the category is hidden until you add a favorite, and All Applications is shown instead.

title: The image wallpaper plugin should allow changing the scaling method
line: Image and slideshow wallpapers get a "Smooth scaling" checkbox; turning it off keeps pixel art and other small images sharp when enlarged.

title: Plasma Calendar widget should gain the ability to show PIM events, like the Digital Clock can do
line: The Calendar widget can now use the same calendar add-ons as the Digital Clock (holidays, astronomical events, PIM events…) and lists the selected day's events.

title: Apps should autostart only after Plasma has finished launching
line: Autostart apps now open only once the wallpaper and panels have finished loading, instead of on a black screen during login.

title: Difficult to differentiate between dates when using alternate calendar
line: With an alternate calendar on, its day numbers in the calendar are now drawn in the accent color, so they are easy to tell apart from the regular dates.

title: `plasma-apply-colorscheme -a` should also enable accent color if color scheme was not already using it
line: plasma-apply-colorscheme -a now switches Plasma to that custom accent color, instead of only tinting the palette while the settings stay on "from wallpaper" or "from color scheme".

title: Alternate Calendar plugin for standalone Calendar widget, as in the Digital Clock widget
line: The Calendar widget can now show an alternate calendar, holidays and astronomical events, just like the Digital Clock.

title: API to support overlay icons on top of Task Manager apps' icons
line: Apps can now put a small overlay icon, such as a browser profile picture, on their Task Manager icon.

title: Show critical notifications on all screens
line: Critical notifications, like a low battery warning, now pop up on every screen instead of only the one with the notification icon.

title: Automatically open browser to log in to a network
line: A new "Open network login pages automatically" option opens the hotel or café Wi-Fi login page in the browser as soon as it is needed.

title: Pasted file/folder on Desktop should appear at cursor position if possible, just like with drag-and-drop
line: Files pasted on the desktop now appear under the pointer (or where the context menu was opened) instead of in the top-left corner.

title: Quick shell change without manually logging out and back in again (under the same user account)
line: General Behavior settings can now switch Plasma to another installed workspace, such as Bigscreen, without logging out.

title: Bond should be a possible VLAN parent interface
line: When creating a VLAN connection, bonds, bridges and teams can now be picked as the parent interface.

title: Bond connection should offer MTU setting like wired Ethernet
line: Bond connections now have an MTU field in their Bond tab, and an MTU set elsewhere is kept when the bond is saved.

title: More descriptive grouped task indicator
line: Grouped tasks in the task manager now show a small arrow pointing away from the panel instead of a plus, so they no longer look like an "add" button.

title: Showing window previews should be delayed until the mouse cursor is still to prevent flashes
line: Moving the pointer over or across task manager window previews no longer makes the screen flash with window highlighting turned on.

title: Global action/keyboard shortcut for existing functionality of toggling audio mute of the currently active window/application
line: A new "Mute Active Application" shortcut (Alt+Mute by default) mutes or unmutes just the app of the focused window.

title: Allow using non-password auth method without having to move the mouse first
line: The fingerprint reader now unlocks the screen right away, without having to move the mouse or press a key first.

title: Hide "Open in file manager" action for blank CD/DVD/BD
line: Blank CDs, DVDs and Blu-rays in Disks & Devices no longer show an Open in File Manager button that only opened the home folder.

title: Option to never show a timezone
line: The Digital Clock can now be set to never show the time zone, even when it shows a zone other than the system one.

title: Applet: make it clear which mode is currently selected
line: The Display Configuration widget now highlights the screen layout button that matches how your screens are currently set up.

title: Show OSD feedback when switching webcam on and off
line: Pressing a laptop's camera on/off key now shows a "Camera On" or "Camera Off" OSD.

title: Button to open default gateway in browser
line: In the Networks widget's Details tab, the default gateway is now a link that opens the router's page in the browser.

title: Allow for smaller calendar widget on desktop
line: The Calendar widget on the desktop can now be resized smaller, and shrinking it far enough turns it into the date icon.

title: Add USB Tethering to dialog Hotspot
line: Phones and other devices connected to a computer as a USB gadget get a USB tethering toggle next to Hotspot, in the Networks widget and in the mobile Hotspot settings.

title: Add visual feedback for "Save session" action
line: Clicking Save Session now shows a "Session Saved" notification once the session has been saved.

title: Align favorites to bottom when panel is bottom-aligned
line: Kicker's sidebar sections can be swapped by dragging the separator, so favorites can sit at the bottom next to a bottom panel.

title: Offer to opt window thumbnail tooltips out of "Enable/disable tooltips" setting
line: Task Manager window previews now keep showing when panel and widget tooltips are turned off in System Settings.

title: Default action for removable devices ("Mount" vs "Mount and Open") should be configurable
line: Disks & Devices has a new "Open in file manager after mounting" option; turning it off makes the device button just mount the device.

title: Inline QtWebview-based captive portal view, so you don't need to open the default browser for this
line: Logging in to a hotel or café Wi-Fi now opens a small built-in login window instead of your web browser, and it closes by itself once you're connected.

title: On Entries config page, focus search field by default
line: The search field in System Tray settings is focused when the window opens, so you can type right away to find an entry.

title: Add a "Maximum energy savings" mode/button
line: Choosing Power Save in the Power and Battery widget now also turns off window and desktop animations until you switch back.

title: CPU Temperature in Fahrenheit
line: System Monitor widgets now show temperatures in °F when your region uses US measurement units.

title: Show active highlight when the activities switcher is open
line: The Activities panel button now shows the active highlight line while the activity switcher sidebar is open.

title: Turn off keyboard backlight the same way as done for the display when using escape key
line: Turning the screen off with Esc on the lock screen (or the Turn Off Screen shortcut) now also turns off the keyboard backlight, and it comes back when the screen wakes.

title: Add NetworkManager version somewhere
line: Info Center's Network Interfaces page now shows the NetworkManager version at the top.

title: Auto-lock after a period of inactivity
line: Vaults can now lock themselves after a chosen number of minutes in which no application has used them.

title: Add shortcuts for new instance and reverse cycling of taskmanager entries
line: Meta+Ctrl+number now cycles a Task Manager entry's windows backward, and each entry gets an assignable "Open New Window" shortcut.

title: Factors should remain visible while you type a formula
line: The Calculator widget now shows the whole formula above the number you're typing and only calculates it when you press =.

title: startkde on systemd: safeguard against already started plasma session in another user session
line: Logging in to Plasma a second time as the same user now returns with a clear message instead of a black screen, and the running session is no longer logged out.

title: Ctrl+Alt+T should open the default terminal instead of Konsole
line: Ctrl+Alt+T now opens whichever terminal is set as default instead of always Konsole.

title: Minimize window when clicking on its icon if it was the last-active window and isn't active only because a Panel widget is active
line: Clicking the task of the window you were using while Kickoff or another panel popup is open now minimizes it and closes the popup.

title: Offer to delete shortcuts to programs in notification (or window) if executable cannot be found
line: When an app in Kickoff, Kicker or KRunner can't start because its program was deleted, the error notification now has a "Remove from Menu" button.

title: Hide swap sensors when swap is not available
line: On systems without swap, the System Monitor sensor picker no longer lists Swap Memory sensors.

title: Show Hidden Icons button could be part of the flow, so it doesn't wastefully take up an entire row in a wide vertical panel
line: In wide vertical or thick horizontal panels, the system tray's Show Hidden Icons arrow now sits next to the last icon instead of taking a whole row or column.

title: Automatically change the screen refresh rate based on power modes on system settings or when it's connected to AC or battery
line: Energy Saving settings get a "Lower to 60 Hz" option per power profile, so the screen can run at 60 Hz on battery and go back to its full refresh rate when plugged in.

title: Add option to not hide all other windows when previewing application tooltips
line: Hovering a task manager preview can now just bring that window to the front instead of hiding every other window.

title: Also show "Reformat or Edit in Partition Manager" action for removable storage devices with no mountable volumes
line: Disks & Devices now lists a USB stick that is blank or has no formatted partition, with a button that opens it in Partition Manager.

title: Inherit global setting for "Navigation wraps around", rather than having its own
line: Scrolling on the Pager now wraps around exactly when the virtual desktop "Navigation wraps around" setting in System Settings is on.

title: Add gestures to the widget
line: Swiping two fingers left or right over the Media Player widget now goes to the previous or next track.

title: Allow Plasmoids to define toggle actions that will be displayed interactively in the expanded view
line: Notifications and Bluetooth now have an on/off switch right in the expanded System Tray, no need to open them first.

title: Media controller widget with "song name" uses more much horizontal space with no option to return to previous size
line: The Media Player widget has a new setting to show only the album art on a panel, without the title and artist.

title: Plasma-nm should do a better job at displaying errors regrading your network
line: When signing in to an enterprise Wi-Fi fails, the password dialog no longer blames only the password: it points to the authentication method, CA certificate and domain and has a Configure button.

title: When an app is installed from multiple sources, differentiate them somehow
line: When the same app is installed from the distribution and as a Flatpak or Snap, menu search and Open With now label the copies "(Flatpak)" or "(Snap)".

title: Show a separator between Pinned and non-pinned applications
line: The Icons-Only Task Manager now shows a thin separator between pinned apps and other running apps.

title: Option in the UI to use WPS instead of a password when connecting to a new Wi-Fi network
line: Wi-Fi networks whose router supports WPS can now be joined by pressing the router's WPS button instead of typing the password.

title: Systray's "back" animation should be sliding instead of crossfade
line: Going back from an applet to the System Tray's item grid now slides the grid in, like opening an applet does.

title: Make all the KDE Clock styles available for the lockscreen and login windows
line: The lock screen and login screen settings now have a Clock style choice, Digital or Analog, and the analog clock uses the Plasma style's clock face.

title: Feature Request - compatibility with passage
line: The Pass widget now also shows and copies passwords from a passage store, next to the pass ones.

title: "Open in terminal" menu item, like in Dolphin (for directory's context menu)
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop now offers Open Terminal Here, like in Dolphin.

title: Task Manager's audio mute icon could have a tooltip
line: Hovering the speaker icon on a task now shows a Mute or Unmute tooltip.

title: Support kexec reboot from GUI
line: Restarting from Plasma now boots straight into a kexec kernel when one has been loaded, skipping the firmware like systemctl reboot does.

title: Add more useful items to "More Actions" context menu of application in Task Manager
line: The task manager's More menu now has Configure Special Window Settings and Configure Special Application Settings, like KWin's window menu.

title: Option for manual inhibition to expire after a time, like DND mode
line: Manually blocking sleep and screen locking can now end by itself after 1 or 4 hours, like Do Not Disturb.

title: Suggestion for adding the feature of panic firewall mode on
line: Vaults can now turn on firewalld's panic mode while they are open, blocking all network traffic.

title: Feature to change existing color that's been saved in the pop-up
line: Right-clicking a saved color in the Color Picker now offers "Open Color Dialog", which opens the dialog with that color so you can adjust it.

title: Show weather description with temperature in non-system-tray representation
line: The Weather Report widget in a panel can now show the current conditions, like "Overcast", below the temperature.

title: delay timeout of notification popups when user appears to be absent
