line: Notification popups no longer disappear while you're away from the computer: their timeout starts again once you're back.

title: Please allow WallpaperFader to be disabled for Breeze theme in both SDDM and Lockscreen
line: The Breeze lock and login screens get an option to stop blurring and dimming the wallpaper behind the prompt.

title: Gesture to unlock the screen
line: The lock screen can now be unlocked by drawing a pattern through a 3×3 grid of dots, like on a phone.

title: Hide the password field when the password is being processed
line: The lock screen now empties the password field as soon as you submit it, so the password's length isn't shown while it's being checked.

title: Allow to set a video as desktop background
line: Videos (MP4, WebM, MKV, MOV) can now be set as the desktop wallpaper and play muted in a loop.

title: Ability to highlight icons across multiple displays in desktop Folder Views
line: Dragging a selection rectangle on the desktop now continues onto the other screens and selects their icons too.

title: [Feature request] Allow users to set a preferred application for the Media Player widget
line: The Media Player widget has a new "Preferred player" setting, and it always controls that player whenever it is running.

title: Fade out when closing
line: The Application Dashboard now fades out when it closes instead of vanishing at once.

title: USBGuard integration
line: With USBGuard running, USB devices plugged in while the screen is locked are now blocked, and you get a notification about them after unlocking.

title: While background data transfer to a device is in progress, Reboot/shutdown can be triggered but will be delayed at the TTY
line: The shutdown and restart screens now say how much data is still being written to disk, and that shutting down will wait for it.

title: Ability to turn off grouping in history, for true chronological view
line: Notification history can now be shown as one chronological list instead of grouped by application, with a new option in Notifications settings.

title: Make it clearer that you can click on items to copy them
line: Hovering an entry in the clipboard popup now shows a tooltip saying that clicking it copies it.

title: Remember settings for tray widgets that are disabled and later re-enabled
line: System Tray widgets that you disable and enable again now keep their settings.

title: Allow to temporarily disable notifications/enter DND mode for individual apps
line: Each notification has a Do not disturb button that silences just its app for 1 hour, 4 hours, until this evening or tomorrow morning.

title: Feature Request: Hold Shift to Launch Multiple Apps from Application Dashboard
line: Holding Shift while launching an app from Application Dashboard now keeps the dashboard open, so several apps can be opened in a row.

title: Pressing Escape while resizing an applet should cancel & revert it
line: Pressing Escape while resizing a desktop widget now cancels the resize and puts the widget back to its old size.

title: "Create New" menu item in context menu for folders, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop now offers a Create New submenu that creates files and folders inside it.

title: Volume keys for active application
line: New shortcuts raise, lower or mute the volume of the app in the focused window, with an OSD showing that app.

title: Lock screen silently drops password attempts after wake or a failed try, so retries end up wrong and trigger a faillock lockout
line: A password typed on the lock screen during the delay after a failed try or right after it wakes is now used instead of dropped, and Enter on the empty field no longer counts as a failed login.

title: Option to enable pipewire-virtual-surround-sound feature
line: Sound settings can now add a Virtual Surround Sound output that plays 5.1 and 7.1 audio as surround on headphones.

title: Show the location for events in the Digital Calendar popup
line: The Digital Clock's agenda now shows each event's location under its title.

title: Make thumbnail/tooltip popup resizable by dragging on edges, as with traditional windows and many other Plasma popups
line: Task Manager tooltips with window thumbnails can now be resized by dragging their edges, like Kickoff and the system tray, and keep their new size.

title: Invisible icon in "General Configuration" preview with mixed light/dark theme like Breeze Twilight
line: With a dark Plasma style and light app colours (Breeze Twilight), the launcher icon preview in Kickoff and Kicker settings is now light on the dark panel graphic instead of nearly invisible.

title: Use HDMI-CEC to turn on connected HDMI screens on session start
line: TVs used as screens get an opt-in "HDMI-CEC" checkbox in Display Configuration that turns the TV on and switches it to the computer when the screen turns on.

title: Support for hardware keys and fingerprint scanner unlock
line: New and imported vaults can be set to unlock with a FIDO2 security key (touch, plus its PIN if needed) instead of a password.

title: Lock screen stays locked when a fingerprint or smartcard succeeds while the outputs are momentarily gone
line: A fingerprint or smartcard match now unlocks the screen even when it lands while the monitors are briefly gone on wake.

title: Feature request: add option to view multiple temperature units
line: The weather widget can now also show the temperature in a second unit, in its tooltip and popup.

title: Include the ability to specify pass file location
line: The Pass widget's settings now have a General page where you can choose which password store folder it shows.

title: Add sunset and sunrise times to weather data
line: The Weather widget now shows today's sunrise and sunset times in its details list.

title: Screen locker takes a second of black screen to activate
line: Locking goes from black straight to the lock screen's wallpaper instead of fading the clock in on a black screen first, though the short black before it remains.

title: Add ability to search for wallpapers
line: The wallpaper picker now has a search field that filters wallpapers by name or file name.

title: Make desktop icons and desktop widgets live on the same layer so they can't overlap one another
line: New, dropped and sorted desktop icons no longer end up hidden under widgets: they skip the space widgets cover.

title: Option to show the date above the time
line: The Digital Clock can now show the date above the time or after it, not only before or below.

title: Desktop folder settings->wallpaper type: picture of the day, today's picture may not be fully downloaded.
line: If the connection drops while today's picture is downloading, Picture of the Day keeps the previous picture and tries again later instead of showing a half-gray image.

title: Centered Kickoff application launcher popup
line: Kickoff can now open its popup in the center of the panel, like the Windows 11 Start menu.

title: Tooltips are shifted up when panel is vertical
line: Tooltips and popups of a side panel now open next to their icon when another panel or bar sits above it.

title: Unlike the floating Panel itself, it's possible to interact through the gap between the Panel and floating Application launcher and widgets
line: Clicking in the gap between a floating panel's popup and the panel (or the nearby screen edge) no longer clicks the window underneath.

title: Option to additionally send weather alerts as notifications
line: The Weather Report widget now sends a notification when a new weather alert is issued for your location, with an option to turn it off.

title: Option to enable or disable "Automatically enable audio for newly connected devices" behavior
line: Sound settings now have an option to stop newly connected audio devices from becoming the default, when the system's WirePlumber supports it.

title: Automatic brightness for keyboard (enable while typing, adjust with ambiend light sensor)
line: The keyboard backlight can now turn off by itself when you stop typing, and in bright light on laptops with a light sensor.

title: Allow multiple Sticky Note applets to reference the exact same note (useful with external screen)
line: A Sticky Note widget can now show the same note as another Sticky Note widget, and edits in one appear in the other.

title: Requesting the ability to group wallpapers into albums from the wallpaper image plugin
line: The Image wallpaper picker can now group wallpapers into albums and show just one album at a time.

title: Show more detailed network activity, like System Monitor's Download / Upload Rate history chart
line: The Networks widget's speed graph now shows the last 80 seconds of traffic as soon as you open a connection's details, instead of starting empty.

title: Layout of favorites grid is not synced after cloning
line: A cloned panel's Application Launcher now shows its favorites in the same order as the original.

title: Do not show the Wi-Fi connection as fully working before confirming if the connection is limited
line: Right after connecting, the network icon now spins and the "connection activated" notification waits until Plasma knows whether the Internet is reachable, for at most 30 seconds.

title: Make it easier for Distributions to customize pinned applications on taskmanager applet
line: Distributions can change the defaults of any widget, such as the Task Manager's pinned apps, with a plasma-<widget id>-defaultsrc file in the XDG config dirs.

title: Plasma closes windows one by one on Wayland during restart -> losing browser tabs
line: After logging out of a Wayland session, a Chrome, Chromium, Vivaldi or other Chromium-based browser that had several windows open now brings all of them back instead of only the last one.

title: Clicking on an action in the notification triggers the launch feedback animation
line: Clicking an action button in a notification no longer shows the app's launch feedback (busy cursor and launching task) when nothing is being started.

title: Widget "Network Speed": Several Display Styles do not show graphical changes in current down- and upload rates
line: The Network Speed widget's Horizontal Bars, Bar Chart and Color Grid styles now show the current rates against the last minute's peak instead of empty, full or fixed bars.

title: Desktop context menu steals relative mouse position from widget config windows
line: With the desktop or widget context menu open, moving the pointer over a settings window no longer highlights or opens items in the menu.

title: With "Keep the selection and clipboard the same" option, in some apps the text selection is inappropriately added to the clipboard history *while still dragging*
line: Drag-selecting text in GTK apps, Chromium or Steam now adds one clipboard history entry instead of one per mouse movement.

title: Weather widget temperature overlay obscures a lot of the current weather icon, especially at small icon size/panel thickness
line: With “Show temperature: Over the widget icon”, the temperature badge now sits in the weather icon's corner instead of hiding its whole lower half.

title: Opening another application cancels launching animation of previous application
line: Launching a second app no longer removes the busy indicator from an app that is still starting.

title: When a notification with a context menu moves down, the context menu doesn't move.
line: A file menu opened from a screenshot notification now stays fully on screen when the notification slides down.

title: Continue to handle notifications even when Notifications tray icon is disabled
line: Notifications keep working without a Notifications widget, for example with the System Tray entry turned off, and a new option hands them to another notification server.

title: The holiday plugin no longer shows language identifiers, making it hard to distinguish between otherwise identically-named entries
line: The Holidays settings page now shows the language of each region in countries with several holiday files, like Belgium (French, Dutch, Walloon).

title: Task Manager font size doesn't update immediately when system font size changes
line: Task Manager labels and other Plasma text now switch to the new size as soon as the system font size is changed.

title: Wrong icon shown when launching same app twice via two different .desktop files that have different icons
line: An app started from a second desktop file with its own icon now gets its own task with that icon, while windows it opens later still join the app's usual task.

title: Race condition between Unity counter service and autostarted apps, causing them to sometimes lose their Task Manager notification badges until they're restarted
line: Apps that start automatically at login now keep the unread-count badge they set on their Task Manager icon.

title: Cannot type the first character with accent in the search field of Kickoff due to search field not being focused by default
line: Accented letters typed with a compose key, dead key or input method right after opening Kickoff now keep their accent.

title: 24-hour config setting in the widget (not systemwide) does not propagate to items in the "Copy to clipboard" menu
line: The Digital Clock's Copy to Clipboard menu now shows times in the 12 or 24-hour format chosen in the widget's settings.

title: Icons in icons only task manager reduce to unusable size when Panel is filled up with other widgets
line: On a crowded panel, Task Manager icons keep their full size and the tasks scroll, with the active or alerting task always brought into view, instead of shrinking to tiny slivers.

title: Applet misleadingly says "no vaults have been set up" instead of a real error message when kded module wasn't loaded is or crashing
line: The Vaults applet now says when its background service isn't running, and shows your vaults again once it is back, instead of claiming none have been set up.

title: Files from vaults leak names in apps' non-encrypted "recent items" lists
line: Locking a vault now removes its files from recent-file lists, the launcher's History and task manager jump lists.

title: Audio Volume applet cause excessive CPU usage when visible, especially when on the Desktop
line: The Audio Volume widget on the desktop no longer records every audio device while windows cover it.

title: Can't pin GUI applications started by script
line: Apps whose launcher runs a wrapper script now show their own name and icon in the Task Manager and pin correctly.

title: Attempting to send multiple files via bluetooth fails, rather than being queued
line: Sending a file over Bluetooth to a device that is still receiving another one now waits for that transfer to finish instead of failing.

title: Option to hide notifications from screencast instead of disabling them (and maybe make it the default)
line: A new "Hide from screen recordings and screenshots" option in the Notifications settings keeps popups on your screen but out of screen sharing, recordings and screenshots.

title: Greeter survives a grace-time unlock; every later lock starts no greeter ("QProcess::start: Process is already running") and leaves a black screen with only a cursor
line: Locking the screen again after an unlock in grace time now always shows the lock screen, even if the old lock screen process got stuck.

title: Quicklaunch passes %u to Firefox incorrectly
line: Quicklaunch's right-click actions like Firefox's "New Private Window" now run the right action without a stray literal %u.

title: No inertia/momentum when scrolling to change month
line: A quick touchpad swipe in the calendar now moves to the previous or next month instead of snapping back.

title: Allow Slideshow mode to skip dynamic wallpapers that lack the active light/dark counterpart during time-of-day switching
line: Slideshow wallpapers have a new "Only show dynamic wallpapers" option that skips wallpapers without both a light and a dark version, so a dark image no longer shows up during the day.

title: Expand "Hide other windows when hovering over tooltips"'s hoverable area into the entire window preview area
line: With "Hide other windows when hovering over tooltips" on, the window now stays highlighted while hovering its title, close button and media controls in the task tooltip, not only its thumbnail.

title: Show battery percentage on the Bluetooth widget icon when there's a single connected bluetooth device
line: The Bluetooth tray icon can now show the battery percentage of the connected device, turned on from its right-click menu.

title: Brightness controls stop working on a monitor that has been off, asleep, or set to another input during an active session, until the session (or the PowerDevil service) is restarted
line: A DDC/CI monitor that stops answering for a moment, such as when switched to another input, keeps its brightness control instead of losing it until powerdevil restarts.

title: Feature Request: A toggle button or checkbox for auto-connecting to a Wifi Network
line: Saved Wi-Fi networks in the Networks widget now have a "Connect automatically" checkbox, so you can stop a network from connecting by itself without opening System Settings.

title: Application Launcher Settings: "Show buttons for" can be confusing
line: The Application Launcher settings now say which actions go into the separate menu when you pick Power or Session for the buttons.

title: Make Diagonal Resizing less pixel-perfect by copying windows easier implementation
line: Widget popups like Kickoff and the System Tray can now be resized diagonally by grabbing anywhere near a corner, like windows.

title: [Feature Request] option to execute klipper action commands without using the shell /bin/sh
line: Klipper action commands can now be run without a shell, with each inserted clipboard text passed as a single argument.

title: Crash in QQuickItemGrabResult::render when double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup (list mode)
line: Double-clicking a folder in a panel Folder View popup in list mode no longer crashes or freezes Plasma.

title: Screen never turns off after automatic lock when "When locked, turn off screen" equals the dim timeout
line: After an automatic lock the screen now turns off after the "When locked, turn off screen" delay even when dimming uses the same delay

title: Re-dragging an item the frame it's dropped causes the item to misalign
line: Desktop icons dragged with a quick flick, or grabbed again right after a drop, now stay under the pointer and land where you drop them.

title: Add support for NetBird VPN (org.freedesktop.NetworkManager.netbird) in plasma-nm
line: NetBird VPN connections can now be created, edited and connected from Plasma's network settings and Networks widget.

title: Allow defining a custom icon for outputs, which then becomes the CompactRepresentation's icon when that output is active
line: You can now give each audio device its own icon in Rename Devices, and the system tray shows it while that device is active.

title: Improve the way you name/rename a hostpot
line: With a long login name, the default hotspot name is now shortened to fit Wi-Fi's 32-byte limit, so turning on the hotspot no longer fails.

title: Search results don't change after initial results after you use a keyboard shortcut to open a menu
line: Global Menu's Search opens empty again and keeps filtering after you close it and open another menu with Alt+F.

title: Can't unmute audio by middle-clicking tray icon after disabling it with button in tray popup
line: Middle-clicking the volume icon or pressing the mute key now unmutes a speaker that was muted from the popup.

title: [Panel Edit Mode] "Miniature desktop" header buttons overlap each other when screen space is limited or large scaling is used when locale has long words
line: With the panel settings open, the buttons above the small desktop preview no longer overlap: when their labels don't fit they all become icons with tooltips.

title: Button to show Virtual Keyboard in KScreenLocker does not work unless the user manually enables Plasma Keyboard in the virtual keyboard setting
line: The lock screen's Show On-Screen Keyboard button now opens Plasma Keyboard even when no virtual keyboard is enabled in System Settings.

title: Window miniatures/previews and tooltips don't float to match the floating "Panel and Widgets"
line: Tooltips and window previews of panel widgets now float away from the panel with the same gap as their popups when widgets float.

title: Option to show the job progress percentage next to the notification icon in the system tray
line: A new "Show percentage on icon" option in the Notifications settings shows running jobs' progress as a number on the tray icon.

title: Clipboard action selection could be easier/quicker
line: Every command in the clipboard's action popup now has an underlined letter, so one key press runs it.

title: Add a dialog for installing .plasmoid files
line: Opening a downloaded .plasmoid file now asks whether to install the widget, with Cancel as the default, instead of opening it in Ark.

title: Show tooltip with the volume of where the cursor is hovering
line: Hovering a volume slider in the Audio Volume widget shows a tooltip with the volume a click at that spot would set.

title: Battery widget freezes plasmashell at 100% CPU when an app leaks many power inhibitions
line: An app that leaks thousands of identical sleep inhibitions no longer pegs plasmashell or clogs its D-Bus: the battery popup shows it once and Unblock works.

title: The volume control via hotkeys doesn’t work in Chromium and Firefox
line: The Media volume shortcuts no longer show a moving volume indicator for Chrome, which ignores the change, and the indicator now shows the volume players really apply.

title: plasmashell crashes in AppMenuModel::removeSearchActionsFromMenu after the app rebuilds a submenu while Global Menu search has results
line: Typing in the Global Menu's search no longer crashes Plasma after the app has rebuilt one of its menus.

title: Background effect and style to match other widgets
line: Sticky Notes have a new "Plasma Style" color option that gives them the same background as other desktop widgets.

title: Unable to disable text formatting unless the cursor is against a non-whitespace character or highlighted text
line: Sticky Note's Bold, Italic, Underline and Strikethrough buttons now switch formatting on or off for what you type next, even after a space or in an empty note.

title: Invalid SSL certificate for picture of the day provider breaking screen locker
line: When a Picture of the Day site has a bad certificate, the lock screen keeps working instead of showing "the screen locker is broken".

title: Mouseover tooltip should include the current microphone volume
line: The microphone tray icon's tooltip now shows the current microphone volume, like the volume icon does.

title: [feature] Ability to change sticky notes font color
line: Sticky notes have a new "Text color: Custom" option in their settings, so their text can be made readable on any wallpaper.

title: Option to choose which device's battery is shown in the CompactRepresentation
line: The Power and Battery icon's context menu now has a Show on Icon section to show a mouse, gamepad or other device's battery on the icon.

title: SNI menu height doesn't take into account panels
line: Very long system tray menus and their submenus now fit between the top of the screen and the panel instead of running off the top.

title: Show the power profile OSD when the profile is changed outside Plasma, e.g. by a laptop's Fn key
line: Switching the power profile with a laptop's profile key or another tool now shows the same on-screen indicator as Plasma's own shortcut.

title: desktop:/ protocol name appears on delete notification instead of the user-friendly path
line: Deleting a file on the desktop now shows "Desktop/name" in the notification instead of "desktop:/name" with %5B-style codes.

title: Allow pinning app in application menu to task manager on only a single activity as with  the task manager context menu
line: With more than one activity, "Pin to Task Manager" in the application launchers is now a submenu to pin an app on all activities, the current one, or chosen ones.

title: Allow the power-saver profile to be activated temporarily at critical battery level
line: Advanced Power Settings has a new "Switch to Power Save profile" option that puts the system in Power Save while the battery is critical and unplugged.

title: Session restore never relaunches tray-icon-only (StatusNotifierItem) applications
line: Apps that only show a tray icon (no window) are now relaunched by "restore previous session" at the next login.

title: If the user manually ended/switched from a limited connection, do not automatically reconnect to it if the current connection is lost
line: After you switch away from a network with limited connectivity, Plasma no longer jumps back to it on its own when the new network drops.

title: System Monitor Sensor widget auto-scales temperature graph to 0-5°C despite valid sensor readings
line: Line charts with an NVIDIA GPU temperature and an automatic range now scale to the real temperatures instead of 0-5 °C on drivers that report the target temperature as N/A

title: Adding a very tall horizontal panel can make edit mode barely usable as it covers the popup
line: Panel height can no longer be raised so far that the Panel Settings dialog no longer fits on screen next to the panel.

title: Hotspot is unavailable when a secondary Wi-Fi device can be used as an AP
line: With two Wi-Fi adapters both connected, the Hotspot button now works and uses the adapter that isn't carrying your internet connection.

title: Web Browser theme does not change with day/night mode despite day/night mode working well on main system.
line: Pages in the Web Browser widget now switch between light and dark as soon as the system colour scheme changes, without a reload.

title: OSD can fail to show on lock screen
line: The volume and brightness OSD keeps showing on the lock screen however often you press the keys, instead of stopping until you unlock.

title: Add Scroll By Row option
line: The Pager has a new "Scroll column by column" option, so scrolling over a 2x4 grid goes 1, 5, 2, 6, 3, 7, 4, 8.

title: Bluetooth (bluedevil*) crashed in BluezQt::ObexTransfer::transferredChanged when trying to send multiples files to android device
line: Sending several files over Bluetooth no longer crashes after the first file or two.

title: Changing the folder view icons size squeezes content in popup/standalone widget
line: Changing a Folder View widget's icon size no longer squeezes its icons into a small corner; they fill the whole widget.

title: Breeze Dark's color pallet isn't consistent
line: With the Breeze Dark colors, popup headers no longer get darker when the Plasma style is switched from Breeze to Breeze Dark.

title: Clipboard's search bar should be Right-Clickable for pasting texts
line: Right-clicking the clipboard's search field now opens a menu with Paste, Copy, Cut, Undo and Select All, both in the tray popup and in the Meta+V popup.

title: The Application Launcher's search bar should be Right-Clickable for pasting texts
line: Right-clicking Kickoff's search field (and any other Plasma text field) now opens a menu with Paste, Copy, Cut, Undo and Select All.

title: Privacy indicators for camera, microphone and screen capture are easy to miss: no app name without hovering, no way to show them outside the System Tray
line: When an app starts sharing your screen, a notification now names the app and has an End button.

title: Add ability to Middle click to show "Present windows" for the virtual desktop
line: Middle-clicking a desktop in the Pager now shows that desktop's windows in KWin's window view, without switching to it.

title: [feature request] add displays-off to the super-P quick options
line: The Meta+P screen layout popup now has a "Turn off screens" option; any key press or mouse movement turns the screens back on.

title: Quitting a background app that doesn't implement org.freedesktop.Application.quit sends SIGKILL, which can be destructive. Consider SIGTERM instead
line: Quitting a Flatpak background app from the system tray now asks it to close normally, so apps like Chrome keep their session instead of being killed.

title: Use a better placeholder icon for widgets that failed to load
line: Widgets that failed to load now show a red error icon in panels instead of their usual icon or the Plasma logo.

title: When entering DND mode hides already-visible notifications, exiting DND mode should not make them appear again
line: Notifications hidden when Do Not Disturb turns on now stay in the history instead of popping up again when it turns off.

title: Cannot rename files in Folder View widget shown inline on a thick panel
line: Renaming a file in a Folder View shown inline in a thick panel now works: what you type goes into the name field instead of KRunner.

title: plasmashell crashes (SIGSEGV in Chromium extensions/PrefService) and leaks memory with 2+ Web Browser widgets active
line: Turning off private browsing in a Web Browser widget no longer crashes Plasma when another Web Browser widget is open.

title: Malformed metadata in summer_1am wallpaper causes repeated qt.imageformats.tiff ImageLength warnings
line: The summer_1am wallpaper no longer makes Dolphin and the wallpaper picker print a burst of "TIFF directory is missing required ImageLength" warnings.

title: No way to configure visibility/history appearance for job progress notifications.
line: Apps that only show file transfer progress, like Dolphin, now appear in Configure for Applications, so you can stop their finished jobs from going into the history.

title: org.kde.PlasmaShell.evaluateScript should implicitly add a newline to the output of print()
line: Each print() in a Plasma desktop script now comes back on its own line instead of all run together.

title: When user selects an older Libreoffice Calc entry, it gets pasted as image into Libreoffice or browsers.
line: Picking an older LibreOffice Calc entry from the clipboard history now pastes the cells again instead of a picture or a paste error.

title: Hard Disk Activity widget goes out of bounds when first dragging it to the desktop from the widget picker
line: Widgets dragged onto the desktop now get tall enough for their contents, even when the pointer stays over them after the drop.

title: Add "Clear notification after 1 day" option to Settings / Activities
line: Notification settings have a new "Remove from history" option that clears old notifications automatically after an hour, a day or a week.

title: Reduce size of Task Manager thumbnails when many are open and they start to become scrollable
line: When an app has many windows open, the Task Manager's window previews now get smaller so they fit on screen instead of scrolling right away.

title: Cloning a single Panel then deleting the clone doesn't make the Editing Mode settings reappear with the single Panel
line: Deleting a panel from its Panel Settings now brings edit mode back to its normal full-size layout, and Manage Desktops and Panels no longer shows up when all panels are on one screen.

title: Clicking Connect while the SSO web view is still loading deadlocks kded6 in OpenconnectAuthWidget::connectHost()
line: Clicking Connect again while an OpenConnect SSO login page is open no longer freezes kded; it restarts the login and shows the page again.

title: The user created a desktop file for the trash and moved a file or folder to the trash, but the trash desktop icon didn't change to the trash full icon.
line: A Trash link on the desktop of a new user now switches to the full bin when something is trashed, instead of staying empty until Plasma restarts.

title: Add "close others" option to close all but the most recently active window in an application
line: Right-clicking an app with several open windows in the Task Manager now offers "Close All Except Last Used".

title: After resume from sleep with different monitor configuration, Plasmashell crashed in KConfigGroup::config while trying to look up panel thickness
line: Plasma no longer crashes when a script reads the settings of a panel whose monitor was unplugged.

title: Drag and dropping task to another virtual desktop inside pager sometimes briefly flickers back before moving
line: A window dropped onto another desktop in the Pager no longer flashes back on its old desktop before moving.

title: Clipboard widget settings don't have an About page
line: The Clipboard settings now have an About page, like every other widget's settings.

title: File properties report does not get updated unlike Dolphin ~/Desktop folder after the file is overwritten by cp
line: The Properties dialog opened from the desktop now shows the current size and modification time of a file that was overwritten in place.

title: When something is inhibiting "shutdown" using systemd-inhibit, shutting down and rebooting from the GUI fail silently
line: When an app like zypper blocks shutdown, the logout screen and a notification now say which app is blocking it, instead of closing the session and silently failing.

title: Widget rotation button can be fully obstructed by tooltip, making it inaccessible
line: On rotated desktop widgets, the edit-mode handle tooltips no longer cover their buttons, so the rotate button can always be grabbed.

title: Show time last updated/refreshed
line: The weather widget now shows when the current conditions were observed, and weather notices show when they end as well as when they start.

title: powermanagement dataengine's `Inhibitions` source is permanently empty: `ListInhibitions` is demarshalled as a type that matches neither introspection nor the wire
line: Apps that are already blocking sleep now show up in the Display Configuration applet's presentation mode hint.

title: Digital clock middle-click calendar launches korganizer-view rather than korganizer. It crashes (missing --view argument)
line: Middle-clicking the clock opens the real calendar app instead of a hidden helper like KOrganizer View that fails without a file

title: While renaming a file/folder with a long name, clamp wheel scrolls to whole lines; don't let half-lines appear
line: When renaming a file with a long name on the desktop, the mouse wheel now scrolls the name by whole lines and no line is shown cut in half.

title: Expose "Create new sticky note" functionality more prominently
line: Right-clicking the desktop now offers Create New > Sticky Note, which places a new note where you clicked.

title: Backlight helper applies brightness on the wrong device scale when spawned while the panel connector is disabled (hybrid GPU, two backlight devices)
line: On hybrid-GPU laptops with two backlight devices, the screen no longer comes back about 5x too bright after it turns off on idle.

title: plasmashell crashes in QSortFilterProxyModel::canFetchMore() when quickly dragging a taskbar icon while something's playing video/audio
line: Plasma no longer crashes when you drag Task Manager icons around and then hover a grouped task.

title: Floating panel remains floating when touched by dialog/child windows
line: A floating panel now stops floating when a dialog touches it, even after the dialog's main window is minimized.

title: Add the ability to enable / disable Pipewire RAOP/Airplay Discovery in System Settings - Audio
line: Sound settings now have a Configure… option to stop AirPlay devices on the network from showing up as outputs.

title: [Feature Request] Add an option to hide certain audio streams.
line: Applications in the Audio Volume widget's Applications tab can now be hidden from their ⋮ menu, and shown again from the widget's menu.

title: Needs an icon for "Smoke"
line: The Weather Report widget shows a smoke icon instead of a "?" when Environment Canada reports smoke.

title: Share KDE laptop's WiFi to Android smartphone over Bluetooth
line: Bluetooth settings now have a "Share Internet connection" switch that lets paired phones get online through the computer.

title: When selecting a small menu first and then a big one, the big one is incomplete
line: In the Global Menu, moving from a short menu to a long one now shows the whole long menu, scrollable when it doesn't fit.

title: .desktop launchers are not executed when Desktop Folder View uses "Files linked to the current activity"
line: Double-clicking an app launcher on the desktop now starts the app when the desktop shows the activity's linked files or a custom folder, instead of asking whether to open or launch it.

title: Remember expanded/collapsed 'Details' state for file transfer notifications
line: File transfer notifications now open with Details expanded or collapsed the way you last left them.

title: "Dark Mode" switch destroys user's theme choices
line: When your look differs from the current global theme, the Dark Mode switch now warns before replacing it, with a Switch Anyway button.

title: RFC: widgets always translucent on adaptive panels
line: On panels with adaptive opacity, the launcher and other widget popups now stay translucent with blur even when a maximized window makes the panel opaque.

title: The keyboard layout system tray layout icon is invisible but still takes up space if no layout is configured and all applets are forced to be visible
line: The Keyboard Layout widget shows the layout in use ("us") instead of a blank space when no layout is configured.

title: In all kicker-based launchers, adding a new widget instance with an intentionally empty  favorite database will reset them to distribution default
line: Adding a new Kickoff, Kicker or Dashboard no longer brings back the default favorites after you removed them all.

title: The close button on the widget explorer doesn't behave like the taskbar close button
line: Closing the Widgets sidebar opened from the panel's context menu now leaves edit mode instead of opening Panel Settings.

title: Breeze Plasma busy indicator graphic looks kind of weird when it's not animating because animations have been globally disabled
line: With animations turned off, Plasma's busy spinner now shows a circular arrow instead of a still broken ring.

title: "External screen" and "Built-in screen" concepts don't apply when only using 2 or more desktop monitors, providing an awkward UX
line: On a desktop with two monitors, the screen layout switcher now treats the primary monitor as the built-in one instead of whichever is listed first.

title: Pre-scrolling the grouped window tool tip to the final entry leaves part of the delegate out of view
line: The grouped window tooltip now opens scrolled to the active window on multi-screen setups, even the first time it is shown.

title: Esc key only closes the panel configurator, while its bottom-right-most button sometimes only closes it and sometimes also exits edit mode
line: Pressing Esc in Panel Settings now does the same as its Close / Exit Edit Mode button, so it also leaves edit mode when you opened Panel Settings directly.

title: Widgets get smaller every time they're moved between screens
line: Desktop widgets keep their size when dragged to another screen instead of shrinking with every move.

title: The dialog to create new file from clipboard contents onto Desktop is modal and block Plasma
line: Pasting text onto the desktop no longer freezes the panels while the file name dialog is open.

title: Clicking a desktop only moves the primary display's desktop when desktops are configured to switch independently per screen
line: With desktops switching independently per screen, clicking a desktop in the Pager now switches every screen to it, not only the screen the Pager is on.

title: Disks and devices panel opens itself on reboot when Snap apps are installed
line: Snap and fstab loop devices no longer open the Disks & Devices popup by themselves or stay listed as removable devices; loop devices you set up yourself still show up.

title: Very small font on the message count and weather badges
line: The temperature shown over the Weather widget's icon grows with the icon again instead of staying tiny on wide or tall panels.

title: Feature request: Change which input devices are effected by Push to talk
line: You can now choose which microphones the Push to Talk shortcut mutes and unmutes in Sound settings → Configure Volume Controls.

title: Make it an actual binary clock
line: The Binary Clock has a new option to show hours, minutes and seconds as whole binary numbers instead of one binary column per digit.

title: Add a "When inactive with no apps blocking sleep or screen locking" condition
line: The "When inactive" command in Power Management can now be set to not run while an app is blocking sleep or screen locking.

title: Show the remaining time instead of the progressbar on click if show progressbar only
line: With only the progress bar shown in the panel, clicking the Timer now opens a popup with the remaining time instead of just a thin bar.

title: Top and bottom row virtual desktops are not clickable when the grid = 5 rows and panel is 52 units tall on 1440p@150% scale
line: The Pager's top and bottom rows can be clicked and hovered again in thicker panels.

title: Bizzare behavour of uptime graph in system monitor widget
line: System Monitor charts of time sensors like Uptime show correct values on the side axis instead of 0:00:00.

title: System monitor widget adds graphs for static data strings
line: In the System Monitor widget's Grid style, text sensors like the operating system name or Plasma version are shown as plain text instead of an empty graph.

title: After connection to Fortinet VPN succeeds, tooltip still says "Connecting to [VPN]" until plasmashell is restarted
line: The Networks tooltip now switches from "Connecting to" to "Connected to" as soon as a VPN finishes connecting, instead of staying stale until plasmashell restarts.

title: The 150% volume warning has a glitched animation if the animation are deactivated
line: With animations turned off, the Audio Volume popup's "Raise maximum volume" warning now appears in one clean step instead of flashing over the switch first.

title: Option for a thin version
line: Peek at Desktop and Minimize All can now be shown as a thin strip in the panel instead of a square icon.

title: When using  "Show only tasks > From the current screen", Task Manager doesn't show open windows after monitor-related changes (plug/unplug, scale change)
line: After docking and closing the lid, a task manager showing only the current screen's tasks now lists the windows on that screen instead of none.

title: Add support for HTML rich text in Calendar Events in Calendar widget
line: Calendar event titles with formatting now show bold, italic and colored text in the Digital Clock's event list instead of raw HTML tags.

title: Feature Request: Option to sync Keyboard Backlight with Night Color (Sunset/Sunrise)
line: Power Management settings have a new "Turn off during the day" option that switches the keyboard backlight off in the morning and back on in the evening.

title: [KDE Plasma: Power and Battery widget] Indicate in the tray icon if an app is blocking sleep
line: The Power and Battery tray icon now shows the blocked-sleep icon, and its tooltip says so, when an app is blocking sleep.

title: Once the popup has focus, can't transfer it to the tray icons that are  on the panel
line: Pressing Down past the last row of the System Tray popup now moves keyboard focus to the tray icons in the panel.

title: kickoff can be meta+rightclicked beyond its usual constraints
line: After resizing Kickoff (or any panel popup) with Meta+right-drag, it snaps back next to its launcher instead of staying detached in the middle of the screen.

title: Add more metadata and customizability to standard "About" page
line: A widget's About page can now show a Donate link and the third-party libraries it bundles, each with its license and website.

title: "Don't show minimized" visibility option
line: The Task Manager can now be set to show only windows that are not minimized.

title: Auto-refresh feature
line: The Web Browser widget can now reload its page automatically every few minutes, set in its General settings.

title: [ FEATURE REQUEST ] Folder View - Show Global Menu on desktop
line: With the Global Menu widget in a panel, clicking the desktop now shows File, Edit and View menus for the desktop's files instead of an empty bar.

title: Add the ability to set hierarchy of panels so that a panel can always overlap another panel
line: A vertical panel can now be set to take the screen corners, with horizontal panels making room for it.

title: Hunyango wallpaper does not update accentColor as its color cycles, leaving "Accent color from wallpaper" stale
line: With "Accent color from wallpaper", the accent color now follows Hunyango's background each time it settles on a new color, instead of staying on the first one.

title: Show ETA and remaining data before drive can be safely removed
line: While a drive is being removed, Disks & Devices now shows how much data is still being written to it and about how long that will take.

title: plasmashell loses focus too easily in cases where the user probably want to keep it there instead of focusing thewindow at the top of the window stack
line: Closing the Application Launcher with the pointer on the panel no longer makes the panel vanish when a fullscreen app is open.

title: Warn that already-open apps won't appear in a newly-added Global Menu widget until they're restarted
line: Adding the Global Menu widget now shows a notification saying that apps already open will show their menus there after a restart.

title: Shutting down when systemd inhibitor prevents it dumps the user on a black screen
line: When an app blocks shutdown, Plasma now keeps the session and shows a notification naming the app, instead of closing everything and leaving a black screen.

title: Can't unpair DualShock 3 controllers
line: DualShock 3 controllers now show up in the Bluetooth applet and settings, where they can be forgotten, instead of in the Add Device window.

title: Application Launcher's username requires a reboot in order to change fonts
line: The username in the Application Launcher now switches to a new system font right away, without restarting.

title: Fuzzy clock showing wrong day of the week, calendar widget highlighting wrong day as being 'today'.
line: The Fuzzy Clock tooltip shows the correct weekday in the evening instead of the next or previous day.

title: Application Launcher (Kickoff) text label is huge on a thick horizontal panel, and not standardized in size with any other panel widgets' labels
line: The Application Launcher's text label in the panel is now about the size of the clock's time instead of filling the whole panel height.

title: Application Launcher's search bar's input field requires a reboot in order to change fonts
line: Text typed in Kickoff's search field (and other Plasma text fields) switches to a new system font right away instead of after restarting plasmashell.

title: Pressing shift-Ff10 does not open the context menu
line: Shift+F10 now opens the context menu of the selected desktop icons, like the Menu key does.

title: When overwriting keyboard shortcuts from system tray settings it's possible to close the main window before answering the modal that asks for confirmation
line: The shortcut conflict question now blocks the settings window it came from, so it can't be closed underneath and Continue assigns the shortcut.

title: It is not possible to navigate between desktop icons in folder view using the keyboard.
line: After Show Desktop (Meta+D or Ctrl+F12) the arrow keys now move between desktop icons without clicking the desktop first.

title: Pressing the Enter key on the "Session" button should open its context menu
line: Pressing Enter on a focused button, like the Session button in the Application Launcher, now presses it, just like Space.

title: Right-clicking search results doesn't do anything
line: Right-clicking a System Settings page in the Application Launcher's search results now opens a menu to add it to Favorites, the desktop or the Task Manager.

title: Wishlist: Add UV index, Air Quality Index (AQI) and pollen count to the Weather widget
line: The Weather widget now shows the UV index, air quality and pollen in its details when the provider has them.

title: Timer plasmoid: add stopwatch mode
line: The Timer widget gains a Stopwatch mode with Start, Pause and Reset.

title: Allow arbitrary size for the desktop icons and label
line: Desktop icon size and label width can now be set to any pixel value with two sliders in the desktop's Icons settings.

title: Allow temporary changes to be made from a script only for the current session
line: Plasma scripts can now change a widget's or wallpaper's settings just for the current session with writeTemporaryConfig(), without saving them to disk.

title: If you drag an item on Desktop, hold right-click, then drop the file, the "grabbing glove" cursor is incorrectly shown
line: Dropping a dragged item while another mouse button is held now shows the normal pointer right away instead of the grabbing hand.

title: Auto-Hide Panel when triggered doesn't allow the cursor to interact with the app its hovering over without additional movement
line: Revealing an auto-hide panel with the pointer resting on a task icon now shows its tooltip without moving the pointer.

title: Add "Clone panel" to Manage Panels and Desktops
line: Panel menus in Manage Panels and Desktops now have Clone Panel and Clone to Screen entries.

title: Add the ability to set auto dimming to 100% without powering off a display to allow waking a TV with mouse
line: Automatic dimming can now go all the way to a black screen that stays on, so TVs don't show "no signal".

title: Display switching/configuration OSD always appears on the top-left-most display
line: The Meta+P display switcher now opens on the primary (or built-in) screen instead of always on the top-left one.

title: The Desktop scrollbar when in front of an item, if dragged, will move both the scrollbar and the item underneath it
line: Dragging the desktop scrollbar where it covers an icon now only scrolls the view, without picking up or selecting the icon.

title: Power and Battery widget needs support for "multiple batteries for a single HID device"
line: Devices with several batteries, like earbuds with a case or split keyboards, now show each battery with its own number instead of the same name repeated.

title: Application Launcher's Screen Locker's Context Menu appears for 1 frame after unlocking the session
line: After locking the screen from the Application Launcher's Session menu, the menu no longer flashes on screen when you unlock.

title: Tooltip window previews are partially hidden under scrollbar
line: Grouped task tooltips that need a horizontal scrollbar now grow to fit it instead of letting it cover the bottom of the window previews.

title: Using Icons-and-Text Task Manager and "Fit Content" setting on a panel causes it to jitter and uncenter itself when apps are opened or closed.
line: A centred Fit Content panel now grows and shrinks in place when apps open or close, instead of jumping off centre first.

title: Use relative dates with multiple time zones upon date difference
line: Other time zones in the clock's popup and tooltip now say "tomorrow" or "yesterday" when their day differs from yours.

title: Add the ability to clear all on-screen notifications that require manual dismissal at once
line: Clear All in the notifications widget now also dismisses notifications still on screen, such as critical ones that never time out.

title: display year in 'days' section of digital clock calendar
line: The clock's calendar now shows the year next to the month on the Days page too, also for the current year.

title: Video in downloading process while being dragged don't get a thumb until it's dropped
line: A file you are dragging on the desktop now shows its thumbnail as soon as it is ready, instead of only after you drop it.

title: Dragging and dropping a file below another file places the file one cell over to the right of where it should have been placed
line: Files made with Create New or dropped onto the desktop from another app now land in the cell under the pointer instead of one cell to the right.

title: Kickoff does not fade between Transparent and Opaque like the panel does
line: Kickoff and other panel popups now fade between translucent and opaque together with an adaptive-opacity panel instead of switching instantly.

title: 0% battery warning can be shown when reported battery level briefly drops and then returns to normal
line: A battery level that drops to 0% for just a moment no longer shows the critical battery warning or starts the hibernate countdown.

title: PC3 menus can get cut off or drawn under standard windows because they aren't drawn as a separate window
line: The context menu of a text field on the desktop, like the file rename field, now appears above other windows instead of underneath them.

title: Plugging in a USB headset causes half its notification sound effect to play on the previous and current output
line: Plugging in a USB headset now plays the device-added sound on the headset instead of starting it on the previous output.

title: Digital clock widget shows text in English regardless of the configured time locale
line: The clock's calendar now shows month and weekday names in your time format language instead of the interface language.

title: Feature Request: Customizable Keyboard Layout Flags
line: In Keyboard settings you can now click a layout's flag and pick any other country's flag for it, and the Keyboard Layout widget shows that flag.

title: Dodge Windows Panel is not dodging System Monitor's sub-window
line: A Dodge Windows panel now hides when a dialog, like System Monitor's Configure Columns, covers it.

title: Unrelated files can be selected through other files' "Renaming input field"
line: Clicking the part of a desktop rename field that covers the icon below no longer selects that other file.

title: When replacing files, offer option to move the item where the click was released.
line: When a dropped file replaces one with the same name on the desktop, it now appears where you dropped it.

title: Opening an application that adds a system tray icon causes the blue highlight line for another pinned system tray widget to be misaligned for a few frames
line: The blue line next to an open system tray popup now stays on its icon when an app adds or removes a tray icon.

title: Plasma panel suggestions for tablet mode
line: Panels have a new "Auto hide in Tablet Mode" visibility option: they hide in Tablet Mode and stay visible otherwise.

title: Add an angle of rotation field to widget edit mode for accessibility
line: A rotated desktop widget gets a Reset Rotation button in its edit handle, and holding Shift while rotating snaps to 15° steps.

title: Editing bridge autoconnect in KDE resets NetworkManager connection.autoconnect-ports
line: Saving a bridge connection in the network settings no longer resets its "connect ports automatically" setting to the default.

title: feature request:   add import/export option
line: Sticky notes can now be exported to an HTML or text file and imported back from one, from the note's context menu.

title: System Monitor widget's Load Preset menu is tiny
line: The System Monitor widget's Load Preset dialog now shows every preset at the default settings window size.

title: Blue line is glitchy when transitioning between non-system-tray widgets
line: Switching from one open panel widget to another no longer shows two blue lines at once.

title: Action buttons have an undesired round disk background on the lock, logout, and login screen
line: Lock, login and logout screen buttons now show the Plasma style's highlight around the icon and label instead of a grey disc behind the icon.

title: Make it easier to connect to recent Bluetooth devices
line: The Bluetooth widget has a search field that filters paired devices by name or address.

title: Things related to Samba are listed without a name under Places > History > Folders
line: Kickoff's History now shows a name for Samba locations like the network root or a server, instead of a blank entry.

title: kactivitymanagerd fails to register with xdg-desktop-portal due to missing app metadata
line: The activity manager no longer logs a portal "App info not found" error at every login.

title: “OpenConnect” Connection information is not displayed
line: The Networks widget and the Wi-Fi & Networking settings now show the IP address, gateway and DNS servers of a connected VPN.

title: The focus shortcut on a panel cannot be changed if it is assigned to a panel on a currently unplugged monitor
line: Giving a panel a focus shortcut another panel already uses now keeps Panel Settings open, and Continue moves the shortcut to it.

title: Indicate on the "Applications" tab when anything in it is set to less than 100%
line: The Audio Volume widget's Applications tab now shows the lowest app volume, like "Applications (35%)", whenever an app is turned down.

title: feature request: in the desktop settings dialog, keep system wallpapers and my own wallpapers separated
line: The wallpaper picker lists your own wallpapers first, then the system ones, each group in alphabetical order.

title: Text overlapping in transfer notification in RTL
line: In right-to-left languages the Speed and Average Speed readings under a file transfer's speed chart no longer draw on top of each other.

title: Multi-row view triggering despite plenty of space to not
line: The Task Manager no longer switches to two rows when the panel still has plenty of room for one.

title: Tooltip randomly loses shadow
line: Panel tooltips and popups no longer occasionally show up without their shadow.

title: [feature request] Allow changing night light temperature with global shortcuts
line: New global shortcuts raise or lower the Night Light temperature by 100 K and show the new value in an on-screen display.

title: Expose the type of Corona to scripts
line: Plasma scripts can now read which shell they run in (desktop, mobile, bigscreen…) from a new shell property.

title: plasma-nm fails to read a SAML cookie for a GlobalProtect VPN, then crashes in QWidgetPrivate::windowHandle()
line: Cancelling a passkey prompt during an OpenConnect/GlobalProtect SAML login no longer crashes the network service when the login page asks again.

title: Allow Lock/Logout widget button spacing to match other widgets like the system tray
line: Lock/Logout buttons in a panel are now spaced like System Tray icons instead of sitting closer together.

title: WebBrowserWidget is unable to show Intranet content due ERR_CERT_AUTHORITY_INVALID via QtWebEngine
line: The Web Browser widget now offers a "Visit Anyway" button for sites with self-signed or otherwise untrusted certificates.

title: Multiple services and applications spamming journal with "Failed to register with host portal" ""Could not register app ID: App info not found for 'org.kde.APPNAME'")"
line: The activity manager and power management services no longer fill the journal with "Failed to register with host portal … App info not found" warnings.

title: Request ability to hide/show the default wallpapers located under usr/share/wallpapers under wallpaper type image view
line: The Image wallpaper list now has a "Show System Wallpapers" option, so you can see only your own wallpapers.

title: Add option to set shortcuts for Audio Input & Audio Output switching
line: You can now set keyboard shortcuts to switch to the next audio output or input device, with an on-screen notice naming the new device.

title: Being able to press Super key then the Left Arrow key to use the keyboard on the Panel
line: In Kickoff, pressing Enter on a category in the sidebar now moves the keyboard focus into that category's apps.

title: Request that words which are copied & pasted (or using middle click) into the dictionary widget are immediately looked up without needing to press enter
line: Pasting a word into the Dictionary widget now shows its definition right away, without pressing Enter.

title: Taskbar does not show a normal window from a specific app (UTAU through Wine)
line: Wine apps like UTAU whose main window belongs to a hidden helper window now get their own Task Manager entry.

title: Pinned widgets are stealing focus from Desktop items
line: With a panel popup pinned open, closing a window opened from the desktop now gives keyboard focus back to the desktop, so Delete works on the selected item.

title: Add the ability to copy Bluetooth MAC addresses from the Bluetooth device details
line: The Bluetooth address on a device's page in System Settings can now be selected and copied.

title: Dragged clicks aren't opening widgets if they're released on the border
line: Pressing a panel widget and releasing the mouse on the panel's edge now opens it, instead of doing nothing.

title: panels are not restored correctly when restoring saved global theme
line: Applying a saved global theme puts each panel back on the screen it was saved on, instead of all on one screen.

title: With elevated font size, desktop icons on screens with 100% scale factor vertically overlap when labels span two lines
line: With a larger font, desktop icons with two-line names no longer overlap the icon below them.

title: [RFE] [Openconnect] nm plasma applet should support PKCS11 usercerts
line: OpenConnect VPN settings can now use a user certificate stored on a smart card or security token, picked from a list or kept when saving, in both the current and the new settings page.

title: Allow Line Chart widget to hide trailing zeros in Y-axis when value is an integer to save space
line: Chart widgets now label their Y axis "8 GiB" instead of "8.0 GiB" when the value is a whole number.

title: Auto-Hide Panel elements that only requires hovering can still be triggered and interacted with while it's hidden by dragging and dropping desktop items underneath the Panel's hitboxes
line: Dropping a desktop file where a hidden auto-hide panel would be no longer pops up that panel's tooltips.

title: "Ottawa Macdonald-Cartier International Airport, ON (NOAA)" weather station not updating
line: The Weather Report widget no longer offers Canadian and Mexican NOAA stations that could never load a forecast.

title: Unusual scaling factor makes panel icon highlighting look bad
line: At fractional scales like 130%, task manager highlights now have a solid top line and crisp sides instead of a stripe and faded edges.

title: Global Theme configuration change in plasmoidsetupscripts for org.kde.plasma.battery no longer changes percentage indicator
line: A global theme's widget setup scripts now apply to widgets in the System Tray again, such as showing the battery percentage.

title: Restore playing what was playing before a TTY session change
line: Music and radio that were playing before you switch to another TTY or user session start playing again when you come back.

title: Folder View behaves poorly when in a panel
line: A Folder View in a thick top or bottom panel now shows the folder contents instead of only a big folder icon, as it already did in side panels.

title: Global action/keyboard shortcut for toggling sleep & screen locking inhibition
line: A new "Block or Unblock Sleep and Screen Locking" global shortcut toggles the Power and Battery applet's manual block from the keyboard.

title: Unable to use a stylus to switch to a workspace by touching it to an area with a window
line: Tapping a window in the Pager with a pen or finger now switches to that desktop instead of grabbing the window.

title: Window previews appear at different speeds
line: Moving the pointer from one task manager icon to the next now always hands the tooltip straight over instead of sometimes closing it and waiting the full delay again.

title: Network refreshing can re-order the list items just before you were about to click on one of them
line: The Networks list no longer reshuffles under your pointer when a scan updates it; it re-sorts once the pointer leaves the list.

title: Notifications can overlap panels in Auto-Hide mode
line: Notification popups no longer cover an auto-hiding panel when it is revealed.

title: Plasmoids on the desktop should use KWin's Blur effect and settings
line: Desktop widget backgrounds now use the blur strength set for KWin's Blur effect, like panels and popups.

title: Ability to center a widget in the available space, not just in the center of the panel
line: A widget between two flexible spacers is now centered in the free space when a wide widget like the Global Menu stops it from reaching the panel's center.

title: Global menu displays wrong accelerators and cannot show menus when activating shortcut keys
line: Alt+letter shortcuts now open the Global Menu every time, and holding Alt underlines the app's real letters.

title: Digits in Timer widget in edit mode are darkened even when Breeze global theme is in use
line: Desktop widgets keep their normal text colors while their edit mode handles are shown, instead of turning grey.

title: Network speed graph can't be highlighted using pointer when hidden to some extent
line: Hovering a list item in the Networks, Bluetooth or other applets now highlights it even when it's partly scrolled out of view.

title: Application Launcher has different minimal sizes depending if the Panel is horizontal or vertical
line: Widget popups such as the Application Launcher keep the same size when the panel moves between horizontal and vertical screen edges.

title: Wishlist: Option to reduce sidebar size in the kick off menu
line: Application Launcher has a new "Show sidebar labels" option; turning it off shows the sidebar categories and tabs as icons only, leaving more room for apps.

title: XWayland-using window is not highlighted in Task Manager while showing child dialog window
line: An app's task now stays highlighted in the Task Manager while one of its dialogs is open, also for XWayland apps.

title: Solid Tooltip.svg Assets Not Used When Panel is Solid
line: With an opaque panel, its tooltips are now opaque too instead of letting the wallpaper show through.

title: Application windows appear on second monitor task manager when dragging it near the bottom edge on main monitor.
line: A window near the bottom of a screen now stays in that screen's task manager instead of jumping to a lower neighbouring screen.

title: Windows/tasks grouped into one button don't clear attention required and the panel does not hide
line: An auto-hiding panel now hides again after you visit the windows that wanted attention from a grouped task's list.

title: Feature request: add custom mapping in .desktop file for audio stream
line: Apps whose sound is played by a separate program, like MPD frontends, can now get the task manager's audio indicator and volume controls through a .desktop key.

title: Tabbar margins are inconsistent and do not fill to content
line: Plasma styles whose active-tab highlight is a full frame can now have the highlight around an open panel widget surround its icon or text instead of being drawn over it.

title: Task Manager icons eat the first click made after dismissing their context menu by clicking on something other than plasmashell
line: Right-clicking a task opens its menu every time, even right after its menu was closed by clicking in another window.

title: Desktop entry filename displayed instead of the actual program name
line: App launchers on a desktop that uses a custom folder now show and sort by the app's name instead of their .desktop file name.

title: Muted sound is unexpectedly unmuted after connecting laptop to a dock
line: Sound and microphones muted with the mute keys now stay muted when a dock, monitor, headset or other audio device is connected.

title: Bluetooth widget in a panel doesn't react to middle mouse button
line: Middle-clicking a standalone widget in a panel, like Bluetooth, now does its middle-click action, such as turning Bluetooth on or off.

title: Sometimes audio notification (Pipewire) freeze whole shell
line: A notification sound that gets stuck in the audio system no longer freezes the whole Plasma shell.

title: wallpaper can show through a bottom panel while it de-floats and re-floats, which is very obvious with a dark panel and a light wallpaper Edit: permanently visible, not just when fading in and out.
line: When a floating panel de-floats or re-floats, a thin line of wallpaper no longer shows between it and a maximized window.

title: plasma-apply-wallpaperimage does not respect the 'Switch dynamic wallpapers' setting
line: plasma-apply-wallpaperimage now keeps the "Switch dynamic wallpapers" choice, so "Always use light variant" stays light.

title: Disabling microphone through Audio Volume popup does not allow you to enable it with a keyboard mic mute shortcut
line: The microphone mute key now unmutes a microphone that was muted from the Audio Volume popup.

title: Keyboard shortcut to toggle light/dark theme
line: You can now set a keyboard shortcut that switches between the light and dark Global Theme.

title: An autohide panel's hitbox is half its size when cursor first dragged to the edge of the screen
line: Files dragged to the screen edge to reveal an auto-hide panel can now be dropped anywhere on the panel, including its outer margin.

title: Replace "plasmashell" with "Plasma" in the warning about shortcut already in use
line: The shortcut conflict warning now says an action belongs to "Plasma Workspace" instead of "plasmashell".

title: "Desktop Folder settings" window does not open in maximized state
line: Desktop and widget settings windows that were closed maximized now open maximized again.

title: Context menu does not dodge panel that's in Auto-Hide mode like it does in Always Visible mode
line: Right-clicking an auto-hide panel now opens the context menu beside the panel instead of on top of it.

title: Paired bluetooth devices are listed as "Available" when their bluetooth adapter is disabled and multiple adapters are present
line: With several Bluetooth adapters, devices paired to a turned off adapter now appear under "Unavailable" instead of "Available".

title: Kickoff doesn't have a widget-specific shortcut set, and its config window doesn't mention its KWin-provided shortcut, which confuses people
line: An application launcher's Keyboard Shortcuts page now shows the global shortcut that opens it (Meta, Alt+F1 by default), kept up to date, with a button to change it.

title: Global menu interacts poorly with "focus follows mouse" setting
line: The Global Menu widget has a new option to show menus only for maximized windows.

title: Notification bubbles are stacked improperly when more appear in quick succession than can fit on the screen at once
line: When many notifications arrive at once, the ones that don't fit wait their turn instead of appearing alone at the top of the screen.

title: plasmashell systemd shutdown order and pipewire dependency
line: At logout or shutdown, Plasma now closes before the sound server, so it no longer fills the log with sound errors or hangs on apps still using audio.

title: OOM notification doesn't properly parse unit name
line: When the system runs out of memory and kills a D-Bus activated app like Yakuake, the notification now names the app and offers to restart it.

title: With Qt 6.10.0, Plasmashell freezes when moving a window with a 1000+ hertz mouse and virtual desktop pager visible
line: Dragging a window around quickly with a high polling rate mouse no longer freezes the panel and desktop while the Pager is shown.

title: notification inhibition doesn't restore after crash/restart
line: Notifications stay hidden during screen sharing even after Plasma restarts or crashes.

title: On certain audio setups, "No input or output devices found" placeholder appears briefly after connecting/disconnecting audio device
line: The Audio Volume popup no longer flashes "No output or input devices found" when a device is plugged or unplugged.

title: Networks applet only shows the first IPv6 address which can be a local address
line: The Networks widget's Details tab now shows the connection's global IPv6 address even when a link-local or unique local address comes first.

title: Network's QR code is draggable, but dragging it to Dolphin or desktop does nothing
line: Dragging a Wi-Fi network's QR code onto the desktop or into Dolphin now drops a PNG file named after the network.

title: Use normal text search in clipboard popup by default, not regex (it could be an option)
line: Searching the clipboard history now finds exactly the text you type, including brackets and other symbols

title: With default fonts and certain specific panel thicknesses, the time display bounces a bit when any digits display a 4
line: On a vertical panel, the Digital Clock's time no longer shrinks for a second whenever it ends in a 4.

title: 0px Spacing in Notification popups
line: In the notification history, a notification's image no longer touches the action buttons below it.

title: With the pointer over a scrollable view, scrolling visually updates the highlighted item only after the complete animated scroll effect is finished
line: Scrolling Kickoff's app lists now keeps highlighting the item under the pointer instead of a stale one.

title: kactivitymanagerd database does not clear its data when "Clear History" is chosen from "Security & Privacy > Recent Files"
line: Clear History in Recent Files now removes every record of the cleared files, including files that are still open.

title: uninstalling a symlinked widget removes the destination, not the symlink
line: Uninstalling a widget that is a symlink now removes only the link and leaves the folder it points to untouched.

title: While in edit mode, ESC key doesn't do anything if the pointer is over a Panel widget
line: Pressing Escape in edit mode now leaves edit mode even while the pointer is over a panel widget.

title: Media Frame Widget will not display pictures from a standard SMB Network Share on a NAS, when given a standard path via dolphin.
line: Media Frame now shows the pictures in a folder on an SMB share or other network location.

title: Folder preview leaks over windows and virtual desktops after switching virtual desktops
line: Folder previews no longer pop up over the windows of another virtual desktop when you switch desktops while hovering a folder.

title: Folder previews are affected by keyboard shortcuts which manipulate windows
line: Folder preview popups on the desktop can no longer be maximized, minimized, moved or sent to another virtual desktop with window shortcuts.

title: Copy/move status dialog: using rolling averages to estimate average speed and remaining time
line: The time remaining on file copy notifications no longer jumps around when the transfer speed is uneven.

title: Bluetooth re-enables
line: Bluetooth that you turned off no longer turns itself back on after resume.

title: Can resize panel applets in invalid directions with win+rmb
line: Meta+right-dragging an applet popup now only resizes it from the same edges its own resize handles allow, so it can't be pulled over its panel or off the screen edge.

title: After reboot, cannot get weather info for any location until switching weather stations
line: The Weather widget now loads the forecast by itself shortly after the network comes up at login or after waking, instead of staying on "Unable to load weather forecast".

title: Pulseaudio Volume Control (pa-applet) wakes up all audio devices when opening
line: Opening the Audio Volume popup no longer wakes up suspended audio devices to show their level meters.

title: Animations are not smooth when activating/deactivating Plasma edit mode
line: Leaving edit mode no longer cuts the zoom-in short and makes the desktop jump to full size.

title: "Add event" button disappears if "KOrganizer View" is above "KOrganizer" in file associations
line: The Digital Clock's "Add…" button and middle-click now open KOrganizer even when the hidden "KOrganizer View" helper is ranked above it.

title: ‘New!’ Badge in Application Launcher not cleared when Remember opened documents is disabled
line: Launching a newly installed app from the Application Launcher now removes its New! badge even when Recent Files history is turned off.

title: D-Bus: desktop.reloadConfig() from Plasma desktop scripting does not visually update wallpaper until plasmashell is restarted
line: When a script writes a new picture over the image file already used as the wallpaper, the desktop now shows it right away.

title: "Recent Files" in Application Launcher and KRunner contain entries, that no longer exist, and is slow to pick up new entries.
line: KRunner no longer offers recent files that have since been renamed or deleted.

title: No visual distinction between the "preferred device zero volume" state and the "global mute" state
line: Pressing the Mute key after lowering the volume to 0% now unmutes the speakers at a low volume instead of showing "Audio Muted" again.

title: Level of battery icon does not reflect actual state of a connected peripheral on a desktop computer with no built-in batteries
line: On a computer without a built-in battery, the Power and Battery icon now shows the real charge of a connected mouse, keyboard or headset instead of an always-full battery.

title: Notifications with actions never close upon expiry even when they don't go to history
line: Notifications with buttons that won't be kept in the history now tell their app they closed when the popup times out.

title: Apps are not removed from Favorites database when uninstalled which lowers the amount of Favorites that can be saved
line: Favorites in Kickoff and Kicker no longer disappear at login when some favorited apps have been uninstalled.

title: preview popup’s child popup doesn’t spawn at the correct place if parent was moved
line: After you move a folder preview popup, the popups for folders inside it now open next to it instead of where it used to be.

title: Unclear error message for when trying to connect to a bluetooth peripheral while adapter it's paired to is disabled
line: Connecting to a device whose Bluetooth adapter is turned off now says that the adapter is off instead of showing a generic error.

title: Cannot manually set wallpaper while the wallpaper selection window is open
line: Setting a wallpaper from Dolphin while the wallpaper settings are open now changes the desktop right away.

title: Windows pinned to multiple virtual desktops, and in a different location on each due to tiling layouts, have outlines in an incorrect location on inactive virtual desktops
line: The Pager now draws a window pinned to several desktops at its own tiled position on each desktop instead of copying the active desktop's position into every cell.

title: When connecting to openconnect VPN focus is not automatically on the input fields
line: In the OpenConnect VPN login dialog you can type your username, password and MFA code right away, without clicking into each field first.

title: Volume change feedback sound clips and sounds bad when rapidly changing volume
