line: Changing the volume quickly no longer makes the feedback sound pop or pile up into overlapping chimes.

title: Clicking on first virtual desktop briefly visually highlights the fourth
line: Clicking a window in the Pager no longer makes another desktop flash as highlighted.

title: Media Player's "Media volume up/down" shortcuts should respect the system's volume stepping setting
line: The Media volume up/down shortcuts now change a player's volume by the volume step set in the audio settings instead of always 5%.

title: Icons order gets reshuffled after restarting plasmashell
line: Pinned apps in the Icons-only Task Manager keep their order after plasmashell restarts.

title: Bluetooth widget doesn't show some devices' battery state, despite it being shown in the Power and Battery widget
line: The Bluetooth widget now shows the battery level of game controllers like the DualSense, which only report it through the system's power service.

title: Scrolling on "Other Applications" page is janky while using grid view mode
line: In Kickoff's grid of all applications, the scrollbar handle keeps the same size and moves smoothly while scrolling.

title: 'Do not disturb' notification briefly visible in panel when going into and out of fullscreen
line: The Do Not Disturb bell no longer flashes in the panel when a window enters or leaves fullscreen, and panels on other screens still show it.

title: Plasma desktop and widgets respond slowly to images from web browsers being dragged over them, causing rapid drag-and-drop motions to fail
line: Quickly dragging an image from Firefox onto the desktop and dropping it now brings up the drop menu instead of doing nothing.

title: Calendar from analog clock being different than from digital clock
line: The Analog Clock's calendar popup now looks like the Digital Clock's, with pin and configure buttons in a coloured header.

title: Clock in not-super-thick panel gets covered by timezone tooltip with "show timezone" setting enabled
line: The Analog Clock in a panel now shows its face even with "Show time zone" on, with the time zone in its tooltip.

title: Configuration window unclear on invalid background image settings
line: Fifteen Puzzle settings now warn when the background image is missing or can't be loaded, instead of silently using the color.

title: kdeplasma-addons applets/comic with multi-screen pops up the full-size comic on the wrong screen
line: With several screens, the Comic widget's full-size comic now opens centred on the screen the widget is on instead of the first screen.

title: Klipper copies many unnecessary mime types
line: Copying in Inkscape and similar apps no longer makes them export the object in every format they offer, so copying is fast again.

title: Windows from the same parent application, including different web apps from the same browser, all show the same media preview and controls
line: When a browser plays media, the task tooltips of its other windows and web apps no longer show the media controls of the playing one.

title: Resizing non-edge-touching Plasma Widget away from the edge it's not touching eventually cuts off opposite edge's shadow and removes rounded corner
line: Dragging the free edge of a panel widget's popup now makes it grow on that side, keeping its content and rounded corners intact.

title: Clipboard doesn't paste copied item that then was moved to somewhere else until the Context Menu is opened
line: Pressing Ctrl+V on the desktop now pastes right away, without having to open a context menu first.

title: User's top clipboard item can be pasted on the lock screen
line: Pressing Ctrl+V on the lock screen no longer pastes the clipboard into the password field.

title: OpenConnect VPN connection fails in KDE network applet due to missing SNI in TLS handshake
line: OpenConnect VPNs whose servers need the host name (SNI) now connect from Plasma, like they do with nmcli.

title: Some Plasma Style paddings don't update on Style change until plasmashell is restarted
line: After switching Plasma Style, the Application Launcher's separators, list spacing and scroll bars now match the new style right away instead of after a restart.

title: Filename filter UX is confusing as it's not clear setting mimetypes is also required
line: The desktop's "Hide matching"/"Show matching" file name filter now works out of the box, and the Filter page says when no file type is checked.

title: Floating Panel: KRunner pop up clips into floating top Panel.
line: KRunner at the top of the screen now opens below a floating top panel instead of overlapping it.

title: Clicking on an empty area of the Panel takes away focus from Desktop items, but you can't do anything with focus on the panel
line: Clicking an empty part of the panel no longer takes keyboard focus away from the selected desktop icon, so Enter still opens it.

title: Popup position is wrong for rotated applets on a desktop and popup flashes if the mouse cursor hovers over it
line: Tooltips and popups of rotated desktop widgets now open next to the widget instead of on top of it.

title: When an app cancels logout until you handle its prompt, logging out again loses state for what was open at the original logout (which is what you wanted saved)
line: When an app stops a logout to ask something, logging out again now still restores every app that was open the first time.

title: [Icons-Only Task Manager] When not Grouped, Icons of Pinned Programs cannot be drag-placed past where Pinned Programs would be when Grouped
line: With grouping off, windows of pinned apps can now be dragged anywhere among the pinned apps, and other apps' windows can no longer be dropped among them.

title: The "Total CPU Use" widget's configuration doesn't work
line: Clearing a sensor's label in the System Monitor widget's Sensors Details now hides that sensor's name, so "Total Usage" can be removed from the panel.

title: KDE Plasma built-in Klipper saves clipboard history to Disk and only clears them on exit
line: With "Save history across desktop sessions" off, copied text is no longer written to disk; the history lives only in memory.

title: Desktop images' thumbnails and metadata don't refresh immediately after being overwritten using GIMP's "File > Overwrite" command or other changes
line: Files on the desktop that are overwritten in place now update their thumbnail and size right away, without pressing F5.

title: After switching audio devices using the radio buttons, sometimes both the old and new devices' buttons get stuck in a "selected" state
line: After unplugging the current audio device, the Audio Volume widget no longer ends up with two devices selected or a device that can't be picked.

title: Calculator search results don't respond to clicking on the result or pressing return the way they do in KRunner itself
line: Pressing Return on or clicking a calculator result in Kickoff, Kicker or the Application Dashboard now puts the result in the search field, as KRunner does.

title: Power Management doesn't fall back to normal sleep if Sleep-then-hibernate set, and then hibernate is disabled
line: With sleep then hibernate or hybrid sleep chosen but no longer available, closing the lid or pressing the power or Sleep key now puts the computer to sleep instead of doing nothing.

title: logout applet: keyboard shortcut to interact with widget in widget settings non-functional
line: The Lock/Logout widget's keyboard shortcut now runs its action, or focuses its buttons when it shows more than one.

title: The activity switcher does not change focus between monitors when hovering/clicking on applications.
line: Meta+Q now opens the Activities switcher on the screen you are working on, not the one where the mouse last touched a panel or the desktop.

title: 10% battery notification is not returning when the notebook's power cable is unplugged before reaching 11%
line: Unplugging the charger while the battery is still low now shows the low battery notification again.

title: Newly moved/created files briefly appear in the top-left-most position, before jumping to the correct location
line: New files created or dropped on the desktop now appear straight where you put them, without flashing in the top-left corner first.

title: encrypted drives are not checked for SMART data
line: Disks encrypted or formatted as a whole, without a partition table, are now checked for SMART problems and shown in Info Center.

title: "Activate Task Manager and Icons-Only Task Manager" shortcut does nothing
line: The Task Manager's own keyboard shortcut now moves keyboard focus to its tasks, so arrows pick a task and Enter switches to it.

title: Kickoff menu not centering on the screen horizontally when centered on the panel and it *could* be centered within existing constraints
line: A launcher or other widget placed near the middle of a panel now opens its popup centered on the panel, as long as the popup still covers its button.

title: Size and position of emblem icon depends on thumbnail's dimensions
line: Link and other emblems on desktop thumbnails now have the same size whatever the image's shape, matching the emblem on ordinary file icons.

title: Task manager is trembling/bouncing when new apps are opened while using the reversed direction setting
line: With new tasks set to appear on the left, existing task buttons no longer jump left and slide back when a window opens.

title: Large sticky notes slow down plasmashell startup
line: A Sticky Note holding megabytes of pasted text no longer keeps the desktop and panel from appearing for most of a minute at login.

title: With same app installed from distro and Flathub and pinned to Task Manager, Task Manager icons get confused about which one is running
line: When an app is installed both natively and as a Flatpak, each pinned launcher now shows its own windows.

title: Wifi network connection fails on WPA3-WPA2 transition networks on client hardware that does not support WPA3
line: Connecting to a mixed WPA2/WPA3 Wi-Fi network from the Networks widget now works on Wi-Fi cards without WPA3 support.

title: Application tray icon (Java Embedded Frame): No context menu, no mouse actions
line: Tray icons of Java apps like MinimServer and JDownloader respond to clicks again and open their context menus.

title: Sleep on lid close and via global shortcut do not work anymore
line: Closing the lid, pressing the power button or the Sleep key now puts the computer to sleep even when the chosen sleep mode (sleep then hibernate, hybrid sleep) isn't available.

title: System Monitor Sensor widget presets don't permit some title characters, but the "Save Settings as Preset" button gives no feedback whether it succeeded or failed
line: Saving a System Monitor widget as a preset now works with any title and shows a message saying whether it worked.

title: Notifications with timer to fade out get stuck on their last millisecond when the session is locked, and then visibly fade out after session is unlocked
line: Notifications that expire while the screen is locked no longer reappear and slide away after unlocking.

title: Menu height can exceed available screen height making items unreachable
line: Long Global Menu menus and submenus now fit on screen and scroll, so their first items can be reached.

title: Digital clock: AM/PM is not localized and interrelated issues
line: The clock now writes AM/PM in the case the language uses, so Greek shows lower-case π.μ./μ.μ

title: startplasma reads "LANG" at the wrong moment in time, leading to a wrong value for "LANG" on a multi-locale system
line: On first login, Plasma now uses the user's locale from environment.d instead of the system locale SDDM started it with, and still keeps a locale chosen on the login screen.

title: Bluetooth and battery widgets give inconsistent info about mouse battery
line: The battery widget no longer shows made-up percentages for devices that only report a rough level, and no longer warns about them.

title: keyboard accelerators not working properly
line: Pressing Alt with a letter no longer triggers icon-only buttons in Plasma popups, such as the system tray's Keep Open pin on Alt+K.

title: Logout inhibition for GTK apps under Wayland is ignored
line: Logging out no longer ignores apps that block it through the desktop portal, such as GTK apps with unsaved documents; the logout is canceled with a notification.

title: Absolute icon paths in desktop files are ignored when icon is displayed in KRunner and Kickoff/kicker/dashboard/etc
line: Apps whose desktop file points to an icon file by full path now show that file in Kickoff and KRunner instead of a theme icon with the same name.

title: Occasional errors saying "The access point /org/freedesktop/NetworkManager/AccessPoint/542 was not in the scan list"
line: Connecting to a new Wi-Fi network no longer fails with "not in the scan list" when the network was rescanned while you typed the password.

title: On-demand icons (e.g. Discover Notifier) can't be configured in the System Tray settings dialog until they become visible
line: The Updates entry is always listed in the System Tray settings, so it can be set to Always show or Never show even when there are no updates.

title: Extremely high CPU usage when selecting, highlighting files and folders
line: Moving the pointer over a desktop full of icons uses about half as much CPU as before.

title: add an option to enable or disable scroll with mouse wheel when cursor is on virtual desktop pager
line: The Pager has a new "Scrolling switches virtual desktops" option, so scrolling over it by accident no longer flips desktops.

title: System unusable when application dashboard has lots of shorcuts to load
line: Application Dashboard no longer freezes Plasma for many seconds after opening when thousands of apps or shortcuts are installed.

title: qt.qml.signalhandler: Property 'onPressed' of object QQuickMouseArea_QML_94 is a signal handler. You should not call it directly.
line: Clicking items in the System Tray no longer fills the log with a 'signal handler, you should not call it directly' warning.

title: Delegate expansion highlight animation does not match content animation
line: When you expand or collapse an item in the Networks, Bluetooth or Disks & Devices popups, the blue highlight now grows and shrinks together with it instead of lagging behind.

title: Selecting many .desktop files on the desktop causes extreme lag on high-resolution screens
line: Dragging a selection rectangle over many desktop icons no longer makes the desktop lag.

title: OpenConnect Pulse support incomplete
line: OpenConnect VPN settings now have a "Disable UDP (DTLS and ESP)" checkbox, needed by many Pulse Connect Secure gateways.

title: Plasma shell terminated by kernel for memory usage when deleting a .ics calendar from KOrganizer
line: Deleting a calendar shown in the clock's PIM events no longer freezes Plasma and fills memory until it is killed.

title: battery applet should not report that the power supply is not powerful enough to charge battery when it is above the stop charge limit
line: When a plugged-in laptop is discharging because the battery is above its charge limit, the battery tooltip now shows the charge limit instead of saying the power supply is too weak.

title: Custom right-click menu for WINE system tray icon is mis-positioned when using a fractional scale factor
line: Right-clicking a Wine or other XEmbed tray icon on Wayland opens its menu at the icon again when screens use different or fractional scales.

title: startplasma breaks variable merging between profile.d and environment.d
line: Variables set in environment.d and extended by Plasma's env scripts now keep both parts instead of losing the environment.d value.

title: Slideshow wallpaper changes when turning off and on the monitor, even if this would be too early based on the chosen switching frequency
line: A slideshow wallpaper keeps its current image when a monitor is turned off and on, until its interval is over.

title: Copying large images can make Plasma freeze
line: Copying a large image together with its file name (as Gwenview does) no longer freezes Plasma while the image is transferred, when the clipboard isn't set to save images.

title: "Remote control requested" dialog shows up after clicking on the tray icon of certain apps
line: Clicking the tray icon of GTK3, Electron and other legacy apps no longer pops up a "Remote Control" permission dialog; the click just reaches the app.

title: Default wallpaper is showed for a second after login, before slideshow starts
line: With a slideshow wallpaper, the desktop no longer flashes the default wallpaper at login before the slideshow image appears.

title: After disconnecting from an expanded VPN: the network item below expands and the configure button overlays content
line: Disconnecting an expanded VPN no longer makes the network that takes its place in the list show up expanded.

title: "Focus Follows Mouse" focus modes are not compatible with floating widgets on a not-always-visible Panel
line: With focus follows mouse, moving slowly from a floating panel into its open popup no longer closes the popup and hides the panel.

title: "Show alternatives" popup partially overlaps horizontal panel when invoked from a widget at the edge of the panel
line: The Show Alternatives popup of a panel widget now opens fully outside the panel instead of partly under it.

title: Wireguard VPNs are inappropriately filtered out before other connections are active
line: WireGuard connections now show up in the Networks widget and can be connected even when no other network is connected.

title: Pairing new device dialog: Misleading message "Your Bluetooth adapter is not pairable." if one of two Bluetooth adapters are enabled
line: With two Bluetooth adapters and one turned off, the Add Bluetooth Device window no longer says the adapter is not pairable, and Make Pairable no longer turns the disabled adapter back on.

title: Too much blank space in panel popup
line: Clicking a panel Timer that only shows a progress bar now opens a popup with the time, instead of a big empty one.

title: Taskbar floating causes hovering and selecting in Virtual Desktop indicator/pager widget to not work normally
line: In a panel, every row of the Pager can now be hovered and clicked, including the top and bottom rows.

title: With a short screen, Notification about removing an applet is partially off screen while "Show Panel Configuration" is active
line: On short screens, notifications now stay fully visible instead of being pushed off the top of the screen by the panel settings dialog.

title: power button shows when no such hardware button exists
line: Power Management settings no longer show the power button setting on devices that have no power button.

title: Night Light System Tray toggle does not function after Night Light has been turned off with a keyboard shortcut
line: After suspending Night Light with its keyboard shortcut, the Brightness and Color widget's switch can resume it again.

title: Frequent changing of Window Icon slows Plasmashell if TaskManager is present on a panel
line: A window that changes its icon many times per second no longer makes Plasma slow, eat memory and finally crash.

title: INVOCATION_ID and JOURNAL_STREAM environment variables should not be propagated from plasmashell
line: Apps launched from Plasma no longer inherit Plasma's own INVOCATION_ID and JOURNAL_STREAM; they get their own unit's values or none.

title: Last used grouped window is not highlighted when textual list is activated
line: The textual list of a grouped task now highlights the window you used last, not always the top one.

title: No settings for the calendar pop up on some clocks widgets
line: Fuzzy Clock now has a Calendar settings page to choose the first day of the week and show week numbers in its popup calendar.

title: [openconnect] crashes inside libopenconnect: ctx->form->opts->_value not set
line: Cancelling a GlobalProtect single sign-on login no longer crashes kded.

title: Powerdevil does not respect lid-switch inhibitor created with systemd-inhibit
line: Closing the lid no longer suspends the laptop while a program holds a handle-lid-switch inhibitor, such as systemd-inhibit; it suspends once that inhibitor is released.

title: Title of playing music is often elided  in the screen locker
line: The lock screen's media controls now widen to show the song title instead of cutting it off at the password field's width.

title: Moving an item to a grouped entry shows list rather than previews, highlight does not follow mouse
line: Dragging a file onto a grouped task now opens the window previews, highlights the hovered one and raises that window.

title: Drag and Drop App from icon task bar in desired Activity not working (move to activity or copy to activity)
line: Dropping a task manager entry on an activity in the Activity Manager sidebar now moves the window there or also shows it there.

title: Tray Icons settings window is closed when you open settings of one of its entries
line: Opening an entry's settings from the System Tray settings, in a panel or on the desktop, now keeps the System Tray settings open with their unapplied changes.

title: Browser doesn't show iframe contents anymore
line: The Web Browser widget now shows iframes and other remote content in local HTML files.

title: Activities shortcut location is in plasmashell, which is confusing
line: The Switch to Next/Previous Activity shortcuts now sit under Activity Manager, next to the shortcuts for each activity.

title: Launchers pinned to specific activity move different launchers on other activities
line: Reordering launchers on one activity no longer moves the launchers pinned to other activities.

title: Uneven spacing between desktops when fractionally scaled
line: With fractional scaling, the gaps between the desktops in the Pager are now all the same width.

title: Plasma can be DDOSed by applications sending too many notifications in short intervals
line: An app that floods Plasma with notifications no longer freezes the shell: each app can show at most 50 new notifications every 10 seconds.

title: plasmashell doesn't wait for kconf_update
line: Plasma now waits for settings updates to finish before starting the desktop, so upgraded settings like non-floating panels are kept.

title: Global menu items disappear when a pop-up window opens, but don't show up again after it closes
line: The Global Menu no longer goes empty when an app opens a dialog, and the app's menus are still there after the dialog closes.

title: Desktop Folder Settings: It's too easy to remove the ability to open the context menu - when it's gone, it's no longer possible to open the settings
line: The Mouse Actions page now warns that removing the Standard Menu action leaves the desktop without a context menu, and how to reopen its settings.

title: Icon Briefly Jumps back to Original Position when Dragged Across Monitors.
line: Dragging a desktop icon to another screen no longer makes it flash back at its old spot before it appears where it was dropped.

title: Deleting the Notifications widget to which notifications are bound to makes them appear in top-left corner until plasmashell is restarted, even if there's already another Notifications widget they could appear near
line: After removing the System Tray that notifications appear next to, new notifications now appear next to the remaining System Tray right away.

title: Binary clock is not displayed in the panel under certain panel thicknesses
line: The Binary Clock now shows its dots in thin horizontal panels instead of an empty space, and bigger dots in thicker ones.

title: clicking Save page and  view source context menu items have no result
line: In the Web Browser widget, "Save page" now saves the page to Downloads and "View page source" shows the source in the widget.

title: Desktop files/folders dragged from one screen to another lose their arrangement and become alphabetically sorted in a line
line: Icons dragged together from one screen to another now keep their arrangement and order instead of landing in a row.

title: Activating the "Minimize All" widget should close open Panel popups, as the "Peek at Desktop" one does
line: Clicking Minimize All Windows now also closes an open Kickoff or System Tray popup, including the tray's hidden icons view, like Peek at Desktop does.

title: PlasmaQuick::Dialogs are inappropriately translucent if kwin blur effect is disabled
line: With the Blur effect off, Plasma popups, Application Menu submenus and tooltips are now opaque instead of showing the desktop through them.

title: Bluetooth setting shows misleading message when systemd service for it is disabled
line: When the Bluetooth service isn't running, the Bluetooth settings page and applet now say so instead of "No devices paired" or offering to enable Bluetooth.

title: Decrease connection speed precision
line: The Networks widget now shows connection speed rounded with the right unit (1.2 GBit/s, 867 MBit/s) and hides it when the speed is unknown.

title: When disconnecting secondary screen that has the system's only panel, the new primary screen has no panel
line: When you unplug a screen that has your only panels, those panels move to the remaining screen and go back when you plug it in again.

title: Can't Set Image as Wallpaper by Dragging and Dropping to Desktop in a Wayland Session
line: Dropping an image from a web browser onto the desktop and choosing Set Image now makes it the wallpaper.

title: Cannot scroll through Digital Clock's Calendar pages with a single mouse scroll step
line: One step of the mouse wheel over the clock's calendar now moves exactly one month (or year or decade) instead of nudging and snapping back.

title: Fuzzy clock overflows when on vertical panel
line: The Fuzzy Clock now wraps its text onto several lines in a vertical panel instead of spilling past the panel's edges.

title: Symlinked images are not displayed in the slideshow for desktop background
line: Slideshow folders now show symlinks to images that live inside installed wallpaper packages.

title: Dropping a file far on top of the desktop teleports it to the bottom
line: Dropping a desktop icon past the edge of the screen now puts it in the nearest cell instead of sending it to the opposite side.

title: Login scripts do not work if they are in a hidden directory or are a hidden file themselves
line: A hidden login script such as ~/.script.sh now runs at login and stays listed on the Autostart page.

title: Excessively large side margins for non-floating space-filling panel
line: The first and last widgets on a panel now sit closer to the screen edges, as in Plasma 5, and text widgets keep their room.

title: After enabling ipv6 and then reconnecting, ipv6 addresses are not shown in the "Details" tab of plasma-nm applet until Plasma is restarted
line: IPv6 addresses that arrive a moment after connecting now appear in the Networks widget's Details tab without restarting Plasma.

title: Menu key press on a desktop applet opens context menu in the top left corner of the screen
line: Pressing the Menu key on the desktop or a desktop widget now opens the context menu centred on it instead of in the top left corner of the screen.

title: Long indicator text can overflow bounding box and overlap into adjacent icons inside System Tray
line: Long keyboard layout names like "latam" now shrink to fit their System Tray spot instead of running into the icons next to them.

title: Switching between Activities very slow (background takes a second to refresh)
line: Switching activities no longer flashes a black desktop: the new wallpaper slides in over the old one.

title: "Strikeout" and "Underline" effects are not applied to fonts of Digital Clock
line: Underline and Strikeout chosen in the Digital Clock's font dialog now show on the clock.

title: Dragging a text file to e.g. kate in the Quicklauncher doesn't open kate but inserts the file next to it
line: Dropping a file onto an app in Quick Launch now opens the file with that app.

title: Lock screen does not blur background image if it is activated twice in a row
line: Locking the screen twice in quick succession no longer leaves the lock screen wallpaper unblurred.

title: Not very usable when using a desktop arrangement that's different from the panel's orientation
line: A Pager in a vertical panel now shows desktops that are in one row as a usable column, and vice versa in horizontal panels.

title: Closing the global menu with the Esc key inappropriately triggers panel auto-hide when the cursor was still hovering over the panel
line: An auto-hide panel no longer hides when you close one of its menus (like the Global Menu) while the pointer is still on it.

title: Telling people to hit Ctrl+Alt+F1 when the screen locker is broken is not always (or ever?) accurate
line: When the screen locker breaks, its message now tells you to press Ctrl+Alt+F3 to reach a text console instead of F1 or F2.

title: Notification pop-ups appear partially off-screen with tiny right-edge-aligned panel that's narrower than the Notification popups
line: Notification popups now stay fully on screen when the panel holding the notifications widget is short and aligned to the screen edge.

title: Speaker icon appears on applications that have the same name of the audio context name
line: The task manager no longer puts the speaker icon on an app just because another app's audio stream has the same name.

title: Scrolling horizontally and vertically on a grid pager work in an unexpected way
line: Scrolling sideways over a pager with several rows now stays in the current row instead of jumping to the next one.

title: When a widget pops up from a auto-hide panel, there's a gap between the two during the animation
line: Popups opened from a hidden auto-hide panel now slide in attached to the panel instead of leaving a gap while it appears.

title: kactivitymanagerd pegs a CPU core at 100% when many files are added to the recently used list (recently-used.xbel) sequentially
line: kactivitymanagerd no longer keeps a CPU core busy while many files are added to the recent files list one after another.

title: Different connection is displayed if you disconnect from one with its details expanded
line: Disconnecting a network whose details are open now keeps that network's details open instead of opening another connection's.

title: Hotspot configuration is not reflected unless plasmashell is restarted
line: A hotspot password changed in System Settings is used right away by the Networks widget, without closing System Settings or restarting Plasma.

title: High cpu usage and bad performance while many files are moved
line: Cutting and pasting thousands of files no longer makes Plasma use lots of CPU and memory or freeze the panel.

title: Cannot eject a non-mounted CD/DVD/BD via "Disks & Devices" applet
line: A CD, DVD or Blu-ray that isn't mounted can now be ejected from Disks & Devices: its action list has an Eject entry.

title: "Copy time to clipboard" feature doesn't copy the exact current time when using C locale
line: The Digital Clock's Copy to Clipboard menu now shows and copies the real seconds instead of :00.

title: sddm-theme: showlogo=shown has no effect
line: With showlogo=shown, the Breeze login screen now shows the logo and its shadow at the top of the screen at all times, not only after the screen sits idle for a minute.

title: Desktop in linked filed to activity mode does not format the name of .desktop/.kdelnk files
line: Launchers linked to an activity now show their app name, like "Konsole", instead of the .desktop file name.

title: Widget title does not change when choosing different widget through alternate 5.27.3
line: Switching a System Monitor widget to another one with Show Alternatives now actually shows the new widget instead of the old one.

title: Edited sensor name will be discarded if the user clicks "OK" on the dialog to close it before first accepting the new text in the editing UI itself
line: A sensor name typed in System Monitor widget settings is now saved by OK or Apply even without pressing Enter or the checkmark first.

title: Several Bluetooth errors are not understandable for end-user, or displayed
line: When a Bluetooth device fails to connect, System Settings and the Bluetooth notification now say why in plain words instead of showing codes like "br-connection-create-socket".

title: With LUKS-encrypted disk's password saved in KWallet, mounting the disk shows a password dialog with the password already pre-populated in the password field, instead of just decrypting it without asking for interaction
line: Encrypted drives whose password is saved in the wallet now unlock right away, without a password dialog to confirm.

title: Respect natural sorting preferences from Dolphin
line: Folder View now sorts numbered files naturally (file2 before file10), like Dolphin.

title: Calendar popup becomes large when events pane appears, but does not get smaller when it disappears
line: The clock's calendar popup shrinks back to its normal size when you turn off the Holidays or other event plugins.

title: Left or Right Clicking any area of the auto hide panel while any widget's or the Panel's context menu is open hides the panel despite the pointer being on top of it
line: Clicking on an auto-hide panel to close a context menu no longer hides the panel under the pointer.

title: Audio output level indicator relies on undocumented/nonstandard features and thus only works for Breeze theme
line: The live audio level in the volume sliders is now visible with every Plasma theme, not just Breeze.

title: Media control keyboard shortcuts always work on lock screen even if display of media control buttons is disabled
line: When the lock screen is set not to show media controls, the media keys no longer play, pause or skip music while the screen is locked.

title: Icon size is smaller than that of panel launchers at certain panel thicknesses
line: Quick Launch icons in a panel are now the same size as Icon widgets at every panel thickness.

title: The timer plasmoid lost functions to adjust individual digits of the time by scrolling over them
line: Scrolling over a digit of the Timer in the panel now changes that digit (hours, tens of minutes, minutes…) instead of always the seconds.

title: Widget Explorer hangs plasmashell for a bit when it opens
line: Opening the Widgets sidebar does about 40% less work, so plasmashell's freeze when it appears is shorter, though not gone.

title: Media player: share data with a global singleton
line: Media keys now control the player you picked in the Media Player widget, even when another app starts playing.

title: Number display on timer widget mis-aligned to the top instead of centred
line: The Timer widget on the desktop now shows its digits vertically centred instead of stuck at the top.

title: Respect upower's "should be ignored" tag when determining whether or not to notify about low battery
line: Mice and keyboards that only report a rough battery level now warn when that level turns low, instead of whenever UPower's guessed percentage looks low.

title: When using "Keep the selection and clipboard the same", selecting everything with Ctrl+A puts the entire selection in the clipboard
line: A new Clipboard setting lets you keep text selected with the keyboard (Ctrl+A, Shift+arrows) out of the history, so Ctrl+V still pastes what you copied.

title: Blue highlight disappears after right-click on icons hidden in the System Tray
line: Right-clicking an icon in the System Tray's hidden items keeps it highlighted while its menu is open.

title: VPN secrets dialog is not parented properly, so it inappropriately respects default window positioning from KWin
line: The VPN password dialog now opens centered on the screen instead of in the top-left corner.

title: It's impossible to move apps grouped in the task manager to another virtual desktop with drag-and-drop
line: Dragging a grouped task from the task manager onto another desktop in the Pager now moves all of its windows there.

title: Widget of control audio/video in web browser thumbnails shown in all instead of one
line: With task grouping off, only the window that is playing media shows the media controls and album art in its tooltip.

title: Location config page is always shown regardless of pluginName
line: A widget's settings window no longer opens on a hidden page that isn't listed in its sidebar.

title: Impossible to dismiss the context menu of a xembed systray icon by clicking outside it
line: Clicking outside the menu of an older X11 tray icon (HexChat, Pidgin, Wine apps) now closes it on Wayland, as it does on X11.

title: [Wayland] Launch feedback creates two entries in the task manager when I open certain flatpaks from flathub or when I open apps via shortcuts created with kmenuedit
line: Launching an app from a custom or renamed desktop file no longer shows two Task Manager entries while it starts.

title: Plasma doesn't ask confirmation to delete a note when using its contextual menu "Delete" option
line: Removing a Sticky Note with text from its right-click menu now asks "Discard this note?" first, like its trash button.

title: When muted notifications are unmuted after a set time the notification sound stays muted if the unmuting happens at login
line: Notification sounds are unmuted again after logging in when Do Not Disturb ended while you were logged out.

title: Information from the "details" tab for a network is cut off with long text in certain languages
line: Long labels in a network's Details tab, like Spanish "Servidor de nombres principal para IPv4", now show in full instead of being cut in the middle.

title: Cannot add Wireguard VPN connection when adding IPs without CIDR prefix
line: WireGuard peers now accept a plain address like 192.168.0.1 in Allowed IPs, treated as a single host.

title: Deleting the last visible text item in the clipboard applet clears the clipboard regardless of its non-text contents
line: Deleting the last text entry in the Clipboard popup no longer wipes an image you copied afterwards.

title: Black sliding wallpaper on activity change
line: Switching activities now slides the new wallpaper in over the old one instead of over a black screen.

title: "Open folder with" context menu item for folders, like in Dolphin
line: Right-clicking a folder on the desktop, or in Dolphin's desktop:/ view, now offers "Open Folder With".

title: When notification's main body text is scrollable, scrollview is inset which looks weird
line: The scrollbar of a long notification popup now sits at the popup's edge instead of floating inside its margin.

title: Dragging Tasks onto Activity Switcher does not work if multiple Windows are open
line: Dragging a task with several windows onto an activity in the Activity Manager sidebar now moves all of its windows there, or also shows them there.

title: The activities switching applet doesn't display the wallpaper if 'Wallpaper of  the day' was selected for that specific activity
line: The Activities switcher now shows the Picture of the Day or the current slideshow image on each activity's tile instead of a stale or default wallpaper.

title: No obvious way of accessing System Tray settings after enabling "Always show all entries"
line: When the System Tray shows all its entries, right-clicking any of its widgets now offers "Configure System Tray...".

title: Scroll bar partially overlaps uninstallable widgets after clearing search
line: After searching in the Widgets sidebar and clearing the search, the widget cards no longer slide under the scrollbar.

title: Device battery notifications should be critical
line: Low battery notifications for a mouse, keyboard or headset now stay on screen until you close them or the device is recharged.

title: startplasma-wayland overwrites $XKB_DEFAULT_*
line: Keyboard layout variables the user sets in .profile are no longer replaced by the system default when Plasma Wayland starts.

title: Microphone entry does not appear in list of entries in System Tray settings unless it is already shown
line: The microphone indicator is now always listed in System Tray Settings, so it can be set to "Always show" or hidden even while no app is recording.

title: Text does not have the same size as Digital Clock text when both widgets are on the same panel
line: The Weather Report temperature in the panel is now the same size as the Digital Clock's time.

title: When updating  "launcher" property of Task Manager from JS scripting api, effects are not visible until restarting plasmashell
line: Setting Task Manager launchers from a desktop script now shows the new launchers right away instead of a blank one until restart.

title: Calendar displays events twice on multi-screen setup
line: Opening a second Digital Clock while another one is open no longer lists every calendar event twice.

title: no tooltip with actual values, values not shown anywhere
line: System Monitor widgets now show their sensors' current values in the tooltip, also right after being added.

title: Slideshow gets a new wallpaper every time lock screen is shown even if slideshow interval time exceeds the itmes showing the lockscreen
line: A slideshow lock screen keeps the same image every time you lock until its change interval has passed.

title: "Do not sort" setting in task manager sorts some task items
line: With "Do not sort", tasks keep their order after switching virtual desktops, even when one of them demands attention.

title: "Always shown" visibility mode does not work consistently with "Automatic Load" applets
line: Setting Media Player (or another automatically loaded tray applet) to "Always shown" now keeps its icon in the tray even when nothing is playing.

title: Changing font size is not applied to System Tray until plasmashell is restarted
line: The System Tray popup now picks up a new font size right away instead of keeping the old one until plasmashell restarts.

title: Submenus of KStatusNotifierItem open to the wrong side
line: Submenus in tray icon context menus now open the first time you hover over them.

title: Default sizes of widgets added to desktop from the app should be enough to accommodate their contents entirely
line: Charts added to the desktop from System Monitor with "Add Chart as Desktop Widget" now open large enough to show all their text.

title: All sensors of a group should be visible in Sensors Details section of widget settings immediately after adding the group
line: Picking a "[Group]" sensor in System Monitor widget settings now immediately adds one labelled entry per matching sensor instead of a blank chip.

title: Widget settings closed without applying edited sensor label reopens with editing mode already activated but that does not react to keyboard input
line: Reopening a System Monitor widget's settings no longer shows a sensor label still stuck in edit mode from last time.

title: Single window of an application with multiple windows open cannot be dragged into Activity Switcher
line: A single window can now be dragged out of a grouped task's tooltip and dropped on an activity in the Activities sidebar.

title: Raster tray icons for Flatpak apps that only exist in the Flatpak app bundle aren't displayed
line: Tray icons of Flatpak apps like Steam that ship their own icon files now show up instead of an empty space.

title: Reconnecting to internet after downtime triggers flood of notifications from apps that remained open during that time
line: When an app sends a burst of notifications, it now shows at most four popups and a summary like "146 more notifications from FloodTest" instead of cycling through every one for minutes.

title: Button "Setup a NAP network" in bluetooth connection settings does nothing.
line: The Bluetooth device page now shows "Setup NAP Network…" when the phone has no network connection yet, and clicking it creates one.

title: Setting to add a keyboard shortcut does nothing
line: The Pager's keyboard shortcut now switches to the next virtual desktop, cycling back to the first after the last.

title: SimulateUserActivity doesn't unlock the screen, even when unlocking without password is enabled
line: Calling SimulateUserActivity, as game controller tools do, now dismisses the lock screen while it can still be unlocked without a password, like moving the mouse does.

title: Port lock and login screens to Kirigami.Avatar
line: Users without a picture now get their initials on the lock and login screens, as in System Settings, instead of a generic face.

title: GTK-Apps icons are not visible in the global menu
line: Global Menu now shows the icons GTK apps put on their menu items.

title: Clock not vertically centered when using a time format without a leading zero for hours
line: With a one-digit hour, the clock's time and time zone no longer leave an extra gap and stay centered over the date.

title: Opening system monitor configuration window of an applet instance discards pending changes in any already-existing config windows
line: Opening another widget's settings while the open settings window has unapplied changes now asks whether to apply or discard them instead of silently losing them.

title: Incorrect error message if vault is corrupt
line: Unlocking a CryFS vault with a damaged configuration file no longer just says the password is wrong, and the error now has a Details button with CryFS's own message.

title: Applet: state of presentation mode switch is not synchronized across multiple instances
line: Turning presentation mode on or off in one Display Configuration widget now updates the switch in every other one.

title: Redundant "Power off" and "Power down" actions exposed in global shortcuts KCM
line: The Shortcuts page now lists the power button's actions as "Power Button" and "Power Button Long Press" instead of the confusing "Power Off" and "Power Down".

title: Deleting an *.enc vault leaves an non interactive entry in the widget: Buttons to relocate / delete required
line: A vault whose encrypted folder is gone can now be deleted from the Vaults widget through Configure Vault.

title: Task Manager does not remember customized order of grouped windows after un-grouping
line: Windows you have arranged by hand keep their order after the Task Manager groups and ungroups them.

title: Disk Usage widget only shows information from partitions mounted on boot
line: The Disk Usage widget now shows a partition as soon as it is mounted, and drops it when it is unmounted, without restarting Plasma.

title: GDBus-DBusMenu-Proxy does not work for GTK Wayland apps
line: Native Wayland GTK apps now show their menus in the Global Menu widget and the title bar menu button, like they already did under XWayland.

title: Keep Clipboard Manager service going when clipboard tray icon disabled
line: Clipboard history keeps working, and copied text survives the app that copied it quitting, even when the Clipboard entry is disabled in the system tray.

title: Rename Connect button to Share for shared connections
line: In the Networks widget, saved hotspot connections now show a "Share" button instead of "Connect".

title: Allow changing IP range for shared connections in the GUI
line: The IPv4 tab of a shared connection now lets you set its IP range, and saving no longer erases a range set with nmcli.

title: Wrong mouse pointer over widget scrollbar
line: Hovering a Sticky Note's scroll bar now shows the normal pointer instead of a text cursor.

title: Bridge w/ a slave hangs at "connecting"
line: Connecting a bridge, bond or team created in Plasma's network settings now also brings up its ports, so it no longer hangs at "Connecting".

title: OSD and applet: "Switch to external screen" action doesn't make sense or behave sensibly when there are 3 or more screens
line: With three or more screens, Meta+P and the Display Configuration applet now offer Use all screens, Only use external screens and Only use built-in screen, and they work.

title: Global shortcut for 'Minimize All' doesn't work well with the respective applet
line: The Minimize All Windows widget and the Meta+Shift+D shortcut can now undo each other.

title: Switch activity shortcut order
line: Holding Meta and pressing A repeatedly now walks through activities in most-recently-used order, like Alt+Tab, instead of bouncing back after the first step.

title: "Create a new Vault" windows grouped in task manager are labeled "kded"
line: Vault dialogs now show up in the task manager as "Vaults" with the vault icon instead of being grouped under "KDED".

title: Autoscroll devices when drag and dropping a stream
line: In the Audio Volume popup, dragging an application's stream near the top or bottom of the device list now scrolls the list, so every device can be reached.

title: Global Menu on Panel in one activity makes windows in other Activities have no in-window menus
line: Apps opened on an activity without a Global Menu widget now show their own menubar again.

title: In properties dialog for item in the desktop:// IO worker, "Location" field inaccurately shows "/ (desktop)" instead of correct path
line: The Properties dialog of an item on the desktop now shows its real folder, like /home/user/Desktop, instead of "/ (desktop)".

title: Microphone icon inappropriately appears when an application (like PulseEffects) is using a recording PulseAudio sink monitor
line: When an app only records what the speakers play, the tray now shows a record icon saying it is recording the audio output, not that it uses the microphone.

title: Don't show "Network disconnected" notification after the disconnect button in the plasma-nm widget is clicked
line: Disconnecting a network or VPN yourself no longer pops up a "Connection deactivated" notification.

title: Proper time formatting for locales where AMPM is going in front of time value
line: In locales like Korean the clock now shows AM/PM before the time, as the locale does.

title: User profile picture is displayed poorly when falling back to the software rendering
line: With software rendering, the user picture on the lock and login screens is round with its white border again instead of a square over the frame.

title: Running Steam game can't be pinned to the Task Manager
line: Running Steam games now show their own icon in the Task Manager and can be pinned like any other app.

title: At small grid item sizes, desktop names don't appear in the pager applet, only "..."
line: The Pager in a horizontal panel now grows wide enough to show full desktop names instead of cutting them to "...".

title: Natural sorting for items in activities pager
line: The Activity Pager now lists activities in natural name order, so "Proj 2" comes before "Proj 10".

title: Launchers from alternative locations(e.g. ~/Desktop) are not identified correctly, duplication of windows etc.
line: Apps pinned from a renamed .desktop file, such as a copy on the desktop, no longer get a second task manager icon when running.

title: Top and bottom bezels inappropriately scale vertically, consuming to much space for tall notes
line: Tall and wide Sticky Notes no longer get big empty margins above and below (or beside) the text.

title: Cannot check "plasmashell --version" with DISPLAY unset
line: plasmashell --version now prints the version over ssh or anywhere without a display, instead of aborting.

title: Open but un-interacted-with VPN login dialog suppresses Wifi connection password dialog
line: A Wi-Fi password prompt now appears right away even while a VPN login dialog is left open.

title: "Launch executable file" dialog is modal and blocks plasmashell
line: The "What do you wish to do with this file?" dialog for an executable file on the desktop no longer freezes the panels and desktop until it's answered.

title: Checkboxes doesn't appear in global menu for gtk applications
line: GTK apps like LibreOffice now show the right check marks in the Global Menu the first time a menu is opened.

title: Scrolling to set time is frustrating on touchpads
line: A short touchpad swipe over the Timer widget's digits now changes the time by a few steps instead of jumping by tens of minutes.

title: Activate grouped windows from alternative activities isnt working for taskmanager
line: Clicking a grouped task whose windows are on another activity now shows them in Window View, and picking one switches to its activity.

title: Menus can cause overflow when there are a lot of them and space is limited on a horizontal panel
line: Apps with many menus no longer push the system tray and clock off the panel: menus that don't fit go into an overflow menu at the end of the Global Menu.

title: Logout screen item focus not synced with multiple screens
line: With several screens, the logout screen's buttons now always appear on the screen the keyboard is typing into, so arrow keys move a highlight you can see.

title: Save order of task manager when manually sorted
line: Tasks you sort by hand in the Task Manager now keep their order after plasmashell restarts and when the apps are opened again.

title: kactivitymanagerd does not handle DB corruption properly
line: When the activity database is damaged, Plasma now restores it from its backup at login instead of failing to save favourites and recent files.

title: Folder view should not allow duplicated file deletion dialog
line: Pressing Delete again on the desktop while a delete confirmation is open no longer opens a second confirmation dialog.

title: Icon-only task manager: App being pinned in another activity affects its position in taskbar
line: An app pinned only on another activity no longer jumps to the front of the Task Manager when you open it.

title: Global Menu widget shows and focuses on a useless popup when activated via keyboard
line: In single-button mode, the Global Menu shortcut now opens the app's menu instead of an empty "Global Menu" popup.

title: With non-grouped windows, audio icon shown on all windows sharing a PID and parent program, not just the window actually playing sound
line: With task grouping off, only the browser window that is playing sound shows the audio indicator and volume controls, not every window of the browser.

title: Windows with focus that are not on top are minimized when clicked in the task manager
line: Clicking the task of an active window that is partly covered by another window now raises it instead of minimizing it.

title: Add to Quicklaunch addon possibility to move icons not only out, but also in
line: Dragging a file or desktop link onto the Quicklaunch widget now adds it as a launcher.

title: Desktop Settings -> Mouse Actions -> Vertical Scroll allows you to configure it to trigger actions that aren't triggerable by scrolling
line: Scroll triggers in Mouse Actions now only offer actions that work with scrolling (Switch Desktop, Window or Activity).

title: Unpredictable what actually will be pasted due to copy-only-selection item not being visually differentiated in any way
line: The clipboard popup now marks which entry Ctrl+V pastes and which one middle-click pastes.

title: Removing applet through context menu does not trigger remove animation
line: Removing a desktop widget from its right-click menu now shrinks it away, like the Remove button in edit mode, instead of making it vanish at once.

title: applications implementing real session restore support are started on first Activity instead of where they were left
line: After logging in, restored apps open on the activity they were on instead of all piling onto the current one, and you stay on your current activity.

title: Bad usability of applets/panel configuration/widget explorer/activity switcher with "Focus follows mouse"
line: With focus follows mouse, the activity switcher, widget explorer, panel settings and widget popups no longer close when the pointer passes over another window.

title: Autostart apps and scripts launch before auto-mounted disks are mounted, which can break them
line: Disks set to mount on login are now mounted before Plasma and autostarted apps start, so wallpapers and files on them are there at login.

title: When set to show "applications:/Games"; panel button shows "unknown" icon instead of correct icon
line: A Folder View in the panel showing applications:/Games/ now shows a folder icon instead of the unknown icon.

title: Pinned app disappears from Task Manager when its window is moved to another virtual desktop
line: A pinned app no longer vanishes from the Task Manager when its only window is moved to another virtual desktop

title: Lid close action retries endlessly every 10 to 20 s when sleep or hibernate fails, draining the battery
line: When sleep or hibernate fails with the lid closed, Plasma no longer keeps retrying it every few seconds until the battery is empty.

title: "Uninstall or Manage Add-Ons…" is shown for apps without AppStream metadata and silently does nothing when clicked
line: Kickoff no longer offers "Uninstall or Manage Add-Ons…" for apps that have no AppStream entry, where it did nothing; Tobias's open MR !7390 does this and works.

title: Alphabetical sorting of Icons-and-Text Task Manager icons causes launchers to lose their position when their windows are closed
line: With alphabetical sorting, a pinned app's icon now goes back to its own place in the Task Manager after you close the app, instead of moving to the end.

title: OpenConnect SAML login: embedded web view is fixed at 640x480, identity provider pages are clipped and cannot be reached
line: The OpenConnect single sign-on page now grows when the VPN login dialog is enlarged or maximized, so big identity provider pages are no longer cut off.

title: Secondary timezone displays off by 1 hour when crossing local DST transition in Clock::jsDateTime()
line: The Digital Clock no longer shows another time zone one hour off when that zone's date is already past a local DST change.

title: Clicking the "Trash" link in the file deletion notification prompts the "Choose Application" dialog instead of opening Dolphin
line: Clicking "Trash" in a move-to-trash notification now opens the Trash in Dolphin instead of a "Choose Application" dialog.

title: Context menu for scrollable sticky note text can appear far away from the right-click position
line: Right-clicking text in a long, scrolled Sticky Note now opens the menu at the click instead of far below it.

title: Blank icons in plasmashell and System Settings when icon theme in kdeglobals does not exist
line: When kdeglobals names an icon theme that isn't installed, the panel, tray and System Settings now show Breeze icons instead of blank ones.

title: Keyboard input goes to the first Sticky Note instead of the clicked note in a wide panel
line: The reporter's open MR !1223 makes typing go into the clicked Sticky Note in a thick panel; verified on the rig.

title: Modification label sensors sans effet (renaming a sensor label in System Monitor widget settings has no effect)
line: Renaming a sensor with the pencil in a System Monitor widget's Sensors Details page now shows the new name right away

title: Save stays disabled when the correct password for an encrypted EC private key is entered (RSA works)
line: The Wi-Fi/Ethernet 802.1x TLS editor now enables Save when the correct password for an EC (non-RSA) private key is entered.

title: Captive portal "Log in" opens the connectivity check URL over HTTPS instead of the portal login page
line: "Log in" on a captive portal network (notification, Networks banner and tray menu) now opens the portal's login page instead of a browser error.

title: X11: Windows can remain missing from the Task Manager after WM_TRANSIENT_FOR is removed
line: The reporter's open MR !7387 makes the Task Manager highlight the focused window's task after that window stops being a transient (Java dialogs), verified on the rig.

title: When Smart pen (Wacom) has low battery, notification about it appears every time when you draw with it
line: A stylus or other peripheral with a low battery now warns once, not again every time it comes back into range.

title: Scrolling over volume slider in popup does not keep OSD in sync with it as the volume changes
line: After scrolling over a volume slider in the Audio Volume popup, the slider again follows volume changes made with the tray icon wheel, volume keys or other apps.

title: Desktop icon launch error blocks the whole plasmashell interface
line: An error from opening a broken desktop icon no longer freezes the panel, Kickoff and the desktop until it is closed.

title: For a notification with a job progress graph, "Details" button moves around when clicked
line: Clicking Details on a file copy notification no longer makes the button jump below the speed graph: the progress bar and buttons stay put and the graph opens underneath.

title: SDDM Breeze theme: "Other…" (username prompt) screen has no avatar/label — "Required property realName was not initialized"
line: The login screen's "Other…" prompt shows its avatar and "Type in Username and Password" label again.

title: Progress bar in Task Manager goes out of bounds and also creates a line within itself at the beginning of the process.
line: The task progress bar no longer sticks out past the task's edge or shows a darker line inside it at the start of a download.

title: plasmashell uses several GB of memory and gets OOM-killed when a calendar plugin removes many events at once (DaysModel resets the model once per removed event)
line: Plasma no longer freezes and runs out of memory when a calendar in the Digital Clock replaces many events at once, as an iCal feed reload does.

title: Sharing WPA3 wifi using QR codes from one KDE machine to another does not work
line: A Wi-Fi QR code shared from a WPA3-only network now lets another Plasma machine that scans it connect, instead of failing with a PSK error.

title: Dual-battery setups evaluate low/critical battery thresholds against raw percentage sum (up to 200%) rather than capacity-weighted average
line: With two batteries, low and critical battery warnings now use the real combined charge instead of the two percentages added together.

title: Icon lacks distinction between Not Charging (Plugged in but not charging) vs Charging (Plugged in and charging)
line: The Power and Battery tray icon and popup icon no longer show the charging plug when the battery is plugged in but not charging.
